Experiments on MS COCO 2017, ExDark, and Cityscapes demonstrate that EIVE produces high-quality instance-level saliency maps and achieves performance comparable to, or better than, state-of-the-art post-hoc methods across standard metrics, while substantially improving explanation efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/xjlDestiny/EIVE.git.

</details>


### [173] [Paving the Way for Point Cloud Video Representation Learning Using A PDE Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01604)
*Zhuoxu Huang,Zhenkun Fan,Jungong Han,Josef Kittler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MotionPDE方法，通过将点云视频中的时空相关性学习转化为可求解的偏微分方程（PDE）问题，并利用对比学习结构约束时空嵌入，实现轻量级的即插即用增强模块，有效提升现有骨干模型对点云视频数据的理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于光流的方法因点云序列的无序空间排列难以有效建模时空相关性，亟需一种新的正则化方法来规范时空相关性学习。

Method: 受流体分析启发构建简化PDE，将点云视频时空相关性学习转化为PDE求解问题；通过对比学习结构在时间嵌入与空间嵌入之间进行引导和精细化约束，作为即插即用增强模块集成到现有骨干网络中。

Result: MotionPDE作为轻量级插件，仅增加极小的计算开销和参数量，同时展现出良好的自监督学习能力，在点云视频数据解释任务中取得了有前景的结果。

Conclusion: 以PDE正则化结合对比学习的方式有效解决了点云视频的时空相关性建模难题，证明了该方法的实用性、适应性和自监督潜力。

Abstract: Investigating spatial-temporal correlations, specifically how spatial points vary over time, is crucial for understanding point cloud videos. Traditional methods, particularly flow-based techniques, struggle with these correlations due to the unordered spatial arrangement of sequential point cloud data. To address this challenge, we propose a novel approach that regularizes spatial-temporal correlation learning by formulating the problem as a solvable Partial Differential Equation (PDE). While PDEs have long been effective in the physical domain, their application to novel sequential data like point cloud video remains underexplored. Inspired by fluid analysis, we construct a simplified PDE, and the process of solving PDE is guided and refined by a contrastive learning structure between the temporal embeddings and the spatial embeddings. With this extra supervision, our method, named MotionPDE, serves as an effective, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing backbone models, adding minimal computational overhead and parameters. Capitalizing on the contrastive learning process, we delve deeper into the self-supervised capabilities of MotionPDE, yielding promising results that underscore its utility and adaptability in point cloud video data interpretation. The code repo with trained checkpoints will be available at https://github.com/zhh6425/motionpde.git for facilitating future research.

</details>


### [174] [Exploiting Semantic and Pixel Representations for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01608)
*Hao Wei,Yanhui Zhou,Chenyang Ge,Saeed Anwar,Ajmal Mian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPRDiff是一种基于扩散模型的新型超低码率图像压缩方法，通过三重编码器架构和失真感知重建模块，在低于0.03 bpp的极低比特率下实现了优于现有方法的率-失真-感知权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有极端压缩方法未能实现最优的率-失真-感知权衡，它们通常优先考虑感知真实性和视觉逼真度而牺牲像素级精度，导致重建图像与原始图像存在明显偏差。超低码率图像压缩不仅需要产生极其紧凑的表示，还需要确保重建图像在语义和像素层面保持与源图像的忠实一致性。

Method: 提出三重编码器架构，利用预训练的面向失真和面向语义编码器的高保真特征来补偿冻结VAE编码器提取的有限表示，改进潜在压缩和熵建模。同时引入带有双重特征提取的失真感知重建模块，该模块不仅生成保留主要结构的粗重建，还提供准确的语义级和像素级条件信号来引导扩散模型。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，在极低比特率（低于0.03 bpp）下，SPRDiff在率-失真-感知权衡方面优于现有最先进方法，有效保持了重建图像的感知质量和像素级保真度。

Conclusion: SPRDiff通过充分结合语义和像素级表示，显著提升了超低码率下的重建保真度，实现了感知质量与像素精度的兼顾，为极端图像压缩提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Most existing extreme compression methods fail to achieve an optimal rate-distortion-perception trade-off, as they typically prioritize perceptual fidelity and visual realism over pixel-level accuracy. Consequently, the resulting reconstructions often deviate noticeably from the originals. Ultra-low bitrate image compression is therefore crucial-not only for producing extremely compact representations but also for ensuring that reconstructed images remain semantically coherent and faithful to the source at the pixel level. To this end, we propose SPRDiff, a diffusion-based compression method that fully leverages both semantic and pixel representations, thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity under ultra-low bitrate constraints. Specifically, we develop a triple-encoder architecture that utilizes high-fidelity features from the pretrained distortion-oriented and semantic-oriented encoders to compensate for the limited representations extracted by the frozen VAE encoder, thereby improving latent compression and entropy modeling. To further enhance the reconstruction fidelity of diffusion models, we introduce a distortion-aware reconstruction module with dual feature extraction. This module not only generates a coarse reconstruction that preserves the main structures, but also provides practical and accurate semantic- and pixel-level conditional signals to guide the diffusion model. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in the rate-distortion-perception tradeoff at extremely low bitrates (below 0.03 bpp), effectively preserving both perceptual quality and pixel-wise fidelity in the reconstructed images. We will release the source code and trained models at https://github.com/cshw2021/SPRDiff.

</details>


### [175] [Self-Improving Small Object Grounding in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01612)
*Tianze Yang,Yucheng Shi,Ruitong Sun,Ninghao Liu,Jin Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文证明LVLMs中的注意力结构可以用于小目标定位，无需微调。通过训练轻量级IoU回归器（基于注意力图，Pearson r > 0.67），提出ACS框架（含学习版ACS-Learned和无训练版ACS-Free），在COCO和Objects365上实现小目标定位最多19%的自我提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LVLMs内部注意力模式能否在不进行微调的情况下，可靠地识别小目标边界框，以提升目标定位的可靠性和可解释性。

Method: 1) 训练轻量级IoU回归器，仅基于注意力图预测框质量；2) 提出ACS-Learned框架，利用回归器从多个候选框中选择最佳框；3) 分析回归器学习到的关键层和头，推导出ACS-Free无训练选择器，基于判别性注意力头的注意力熵排序候选框。

Result: IoU回归器达到Pearson r > 0.67；在COCO和Objects365上小目标定位最多提升19%；ACS-Free在所有无训练方法中排名最优。

Conclusion: LVLMs中的注意力结构编码了定位质量信息，利用这一结构可以在无需微调的情况下显著提升小目标定位的可靠性和可解释性。

Abstract: Can internal attention patterns in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) identify reliable small-object boxes without fine-tuning? In this work, we provide an affirmative answer. Attention structure in LVLMs encodes grounding quality-a lightweight IoU regressor trained solely on attention maps achieves strong IoU prediction (Pearson r > 0.67). This regressor powers the regressor-based variant of our Attention-based Candidate Selection (ACS) framework, called ACS-Learned, which selects the best box from multiple sampled candidates to improve object grounding. By analyzing what the regressor learns, we reveal which transformer layers and heads are most critical and derive ACS-Free: a training-free selector that ranks candidates by attention entropy on these discriminative heads, with no learned component at inference. Experiments on COCO and Objects365 demonstrate up to 19% self-improvement on small object localization, with ACS-Free ranking best among all training-free methods, demonstrating that useful attention structure improves both localization reliability and interpretability in LVLMs.

</details>


### [176] [Turing Patterns for Multimedia: Reaction-Diffusion Multi-Modal Fusion for Language-Guided Video Moment Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01615)
*Xiang Fang,Wanlong Fang,Wei Ji,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出反应-扩散多模态融合框架（RDMF），受图灵斑图形成原理启发，将视频-语言对齐建模为反应-扩散过程，通过Gray-Scott模型实现高效多模态融合，在时序定位与高亮检测任务上展现出超越现有方法的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-语言模型依赖静态交叉注意力或提示调优机制，无法自适应建模模态间动态演化的关系，导致对齐效果不佳且泛化能力有限。受系统生物学中图灵斑图形成原理启发，本文旨在解决这一缺陷。

Method: 提出RDMF框架，将视频特征扩散建模为时间上下文传播，将文本-视频交互建模为非线性反应以放大相关特征并抑制噪声。采用Gray-Scott反应-扩散模型设计高效融合模块，并通过图灵不稳定性判据进行稳定性与收敛性的数学分析。框架集成预训练编码器与DETR风格检测头。

Result: 初步实验表明RDMF在识别视频高亮时刻上具有超越现有方法的潜力，为视频-语言任务提供新范式。

Conclusion: RDMF是首个将系统生物学与多媒体研究交叉融合的工作，从理论上保证了稳定的斑图形成，在实践上结合标准组件实现可用性，为视频-语言多模态对齐开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Video-language models are pivotal for tasks such as moment retrieval and highlight detection, yet they often struggle to capture the dynamic, non-linear interactions between temporal video sequences and textual semantics. Existing approaches, relying on static cross-attention or prompt-tuning mechanisms, fail to adaptively model the evolving relationships between modalities, leading to suboptimal alignment and limited generalization. Inspired by systems biology, we propose \textbf{Reaction-Diffusion Multimodal Fusion (RDMF)}, a novel framework that reimagines video-language alignment as a reaction-diffusion (RD) process, drawing on the principles of pattern formation introduced by Alan Turing. In RDMF, video features diffuse across time to capture temporal context, while text-video interactions are modeled as non-linear reactions that amplify relevant features and suppress noise, forming emergent patterns akin to biological systems. Leveraging the Gray-Scott RD model, we design a computationally efficient fusion module that integrates video and text representations, supported by rigorous mathematical analysis of stability and convergence using Turing instability criteria. Our framework is theoretically grounded, employing advanced mathematical tools to ensure stable pattern formation, and is practically viable, incorporating standard components like pretrained encoders and DETR-style heads for moment retrieval and saliency prediction. RDMF represents a pioneering interdisciplinary approach, bridging systems biology and multimedia research to address the limitations of conventional multimodal fusion. Preliminary experiments demonstrate its potential to outperform existing methods in identifying salient video moments, offering a new paradigm for video-language tasks.

</details>


### [177] [Real-Time Generation of Streamable Talking Portrait Video with Reference-Guided Deep Compression VAEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01620)
*Sicheng Xu,Yu Deng,Shoukang Hu,Yichuan Wang,Yizhong Zhang,Zhan Chen,Jiaolong Yang,Baining Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种流式对话肖像视频生成框架，采用因果视频VAE和自回归潜在去噪模型，实现了实时高质量生成，速度显著优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型计算开销大，难以应用于交互式实时场景，因此需要设计一种适用于流式场景的高效肖像视频生成方法。

Method: 设计了一个因果视频VAE用于深度潜在压缩，并引入变数量参考图像作为引导以分离动态与静态信息；扩展残差自编码范式以增强时空因果性；基于Rectified Flow Transformer构建自回归块式视频潜在生成器。

Result: 实现了实时高质量的对话肖像视频生成，速度显著快于基线模型，在真实感、生动性和视频质量上与大型模型持平甚至更优。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了视频扩散模型在高计算需求下的实时生成瓶颈，为流式交互式肖像视频生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Video diffusion models have significantly advanced portrait video generation, yet their high computational demands limit their use in interactive applications. This work presents a framework for streamable talking portrait video generation conditioned on speech audio and reference images. Designed meticulously for streaming scenarios, it features a causal video VAE for deep latent compression and an autoregressive latent denoising model. Our causal VAE integrates a variable number of reference images as guidance, allowing the network to focus on dynamic information rather than static appearance, thereby enhancing compression efficacy and reconstruction quality. Additionally, we extend the residual auto-encoding paradigm to improve spatial-temporal causality handling in our VAE. The generator is based on a Rectified Flow Transformer architecture and produces video latents in a blockwise auto-regressive manner. Our method enables the real-time generation of high-quality talking portrait videos, achieving speeds significantly faster than baseline models. Furthermore, comprehensive experiments demonstrate that it is on par with or even outperforms these large models in realism, vividness, and video quality.

</details>


### [178] [Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01621)
*Muyi Bao,Yuxin Cai,Hang Xu,Zongtai Li,Jinxi He,Jingfan Tang,Chen Lv,Ji Zhang,Yaqi Xie,Wenshan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Goal2Pixel提出了一种纯像素级范式，将连续环境中的视觉语言导航(VLN-CE)重新定义为可导航像素定位问题，通过预测图像平面上的可导航像素点并反投影为3D航点来实现导航，避免低效的低级动作预测，在R2R-CE上以仅7.75次VLM调用（比传统方法少6倍）实现了54.1%的SR和52.5%的SPL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM方法将VLN-CE建模为低级动作预测，存在接口模糊、受限于短视运动基元、需要频繁调用VLM导致效率低下等问题。

Method: (1) 将导航重新定义为图像平面上可导航像素的定位，预测的像素点反投影为3D航点用于前进；(2) 在图像上附加左/右/底部辅助指令区域分别对应左转、右转和停止；(3) 提出可见性感知的关键帧记忆实现长程导航；(4) 引入语义嵌入和坐标感知辅助损失以适配预训练VLM。

Result: R2R-CE Val-Unseen上SR 54.1%、SPL 52.5%，每轮仅需7.75次VLM调用，约为直接动作预测方法(46.62次调用, SR 32.9%)的1/6，在RxR-CE上也保持一致趋势。

Conclusion: Goal2Pixel验证了像素级导航范式在VLN-CE中的有效性，大幅降低了VLM调用开销同时取得了competitive的SOTA性能。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

</details>


### [179] [What to Test Next: Interpretable Coverage Gap Discovery in Driving VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01624)
*Abhishek Aich,Sparsh Garg,Vijay Kumar BG,Turgun Yusuf Kashgari,Manmohan Chandraker*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SliceScorer（缺失切片推荐评分规则）和 SliceNav（LLM编排的验证流水线），用于在自动驾驶VLM中高效发现高风险、未覆盖的操作设计域（ODD）切片，并通过三个驾驶VLM的实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶VLM必须在多样化的ODD条件下准确理解场景，但现有验证存在大量缺失切片（missing slices），导致经验性故障率不可靠，亟需一种可解释、可审计、保守的缺失切片推荐方法。

Method: 提出SliceScorer评分规则，结合暴露基覆盖先验（关注罕见/欠测试区域）和邻居故障先验（从相似测试条件传播风险）。在此基础上构建SliceNav，由LLM根据开发人员查询编排验证流水线（分诊、评分、获取、评估），保持所有评分的确定性和可审计性。

Result: 在WiseAD、DriveMM、Cosmos-Reason2-2B三个驾驶VLM上，SliceNav比先前的切片发现方法更有效地发现高风险覆盖缺口，同时保持条件空间上的多样性推荐。消融实验证实两个评分组件均有贡献，定性分析展示了端到端工作流。

Conclusion: SliceScorer和SliceNav为驾驶VLM的ODD验证提供了一种简单、可解释且保守的解决方案，能够有效推荐高风险缺失切片，适用于安全关键验证场景。

Abstract: Driving vision-language models (VLMs) must accurately understand scenes across diverse conditions defined by Operational Design Domains (ODDs), yet verification remains sparse: many slices are missing, making empirical failure rates unreliable. We propose SliceScorer, a deterministic scoring rule for missing-slice recommendation that combines (i) an exposure-based coverage prior to prioritize rare, under-tested regions, and (ii) a neighbor-failure prior that propagates risk from similar tested conditions. SliceScorer is deliberately simple - interpretable, auditable, and conservative - properties essential for safety-critical validation. For stress testing beyond the declared ODD, we embed SliceScorer within SliceNav, an LLM-orchestrated verification pipeline where the model interprets developer queries to select relevant operators (triage, scoring, acquisition, evaluation) and vocabulary extensions, composing verification workflows while keeping all scoring deterministic and auditable. Experiments on three driving VLMs (WiseAD, DriveMM, Cosmos-Reason2-2B) show that SliceNav surfaces high-risk coverage gaps more effectively than prior slice-discovery methods while maintaining diverse recommendations across the condition space. Ablations confirm both scoring components contribute, and qualitative analysis demonstrates end-to-end workflows from developer query to targeted evaluation.

</details>


### [180] [Pave-GRPO: Beyond Instantaneous Guidance through Principled Average Velocity Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01636)
*Pengyang Ling,Jiazi Bu,Yujie Zhou,Yibin Wang,Zhenyu Hu,Zihan Zhang,Yi Jin,Huaian Chen,Yuhang Zang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Pave-GRPO通过原则性的平均速度分解，在不增加生成成本的情况下，将奖励信号传播到更多中间去噪步骤，实现了细粒度的偏好对齐，显著提升了流式生成模型的偏好优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GRPO的流式生成模型偏好对齐方法由于迭代去噪成本高，只能使用极少的去噪步数进行训练，导致时间稀疏性——奖励反馈只能到达轨迹中极少数阶段，大量中间去噪步骤缺乏直接监督，严重限制了对齐的粒度。

Method: 提出Pave-GRPO，通过原则性的平均速度分解（Principled average velocity decomposition）重构GRPO目标。在保持高效少步组采样的同时，将每个粗粒度过渡等价分解为多个中间时间步的细分子轨迹集合，从而在不增加生成成本的前提下将奖励反馈传播到更密集的时间阶段。

Result: 大量实验验证了Pave-GRPO在不同奖励设置下有效提升了偏好对齐效果，实现了全面的性能提升。

Conclusion: Pave-GRPO通过零成本的时间跨度扩展和全面的时间监督，在不增加生成成本的情况下实现了更细粒度的偏好优化，为流式生成模型的偏好对齐提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Post-training via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. However, the iterative denoising nature of flow models incurs substantial costs when generating group rollouts for policy-gradient updates, compelling existing methods to train with extremely few denoising steps. This temporal sparsity severely restricts preference optimization: reward feedback can only reach a handful of stages per trajectory, leaving the vast majority of intermediate denoising steps without direct supervision and thus compromising alignment granularity. To address this, we propose Pave-GRPO, which reformulates the GRPO objective through Principled average velocity decomposition. Rather than generating expensive high-step rollouts, we maintain efficient few-step group sampling but decompose each coarse transition into an equivalent ensemble of finer sub-trajectories spanning multiple intermediate timesteps. This propagates reward feedback to a denser set of temporal stages for more comprehensive preference alignment without additional generation cost. This design offers two benefits: (i) zero-cost horizon expansion: through the direct reuse of piece-wise group samples and their associated rewards, Pave-GRPO significantly broadens the effective optimization scope under fixed sampling budgets; and (ii) comprehensive temporal supervision: by equivalently decomposing an instantaneous velocity target into a multi-timestep ensemble, it distributes reward signals across more intermediate stages of the denoising process, enabling finer-grained and more thorough preference optimization. Extensive experiments validate that Pave-GRPO effectively advances preference alignment across different reward settings, offering comprehensive performance enhancement.

</details>


### [181] [CanonCGT: Reference-Based Color Grading via Canonical Pivot Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01638)
*Jinwon Ko,Keunsoo Ko,Chang-Su Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CanonCGT提出了一种两阶段框架，通过规范中性中间表示（规范枢轴）实现稳定的参考色彩分级，结合双阶段训练（监督预设学习+自监督精炼），在色调一致性和视觉真实感上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于参考的色彩分级方法存在色调映射不稳定、颜色过度偏移或保留不一致的问题，导致结果不自然。作者希望提出一种稳定的色彩分级框架，解决光真实感方法和滤镜式方法中的色调映射不稳定性。

Method: 提出CanonCGT两阶段框架：第一阶段通过去除固有色调偏置对输入进行规范化（canonicalization），得到风格无关的中级表示（规范枢轴）；第二阶段根据参考风格进行色彩分级。同时提出DP-CGT双阶段训练方案，结合监督预设学习与自监督精炼，允许在非配对照片上训练。

Result: 在多个数据集上，CanonCGT实现了光真实感和色调一致的结果，在稳定性和视觉保真度方面超越了当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: CanonCGT通过规范枢轴和两阶段框架有效解决了参考色彩分级中的色调映射不稳定问题，代码已开源。

Abstract: Reference-based color grading aims to reproduce the tonal mood and lighting of a reference while preserving color harmony and scene structure. Existing photorealistic and filter-based methods often produce unstable tone mappings -- over-shifting or inconsistently retaining colors -- leading to unnatural results. We propose CanonCGT, a two-stage framework built on a canonical pivot -- a style-neutral intermediate representation for stable color mapping. The first stage canonicalizes the input by removing intrinsic tonal bias, and the second color-grades it to match the reference style. A dual-phase training scheme, DP-CGT, combines supervised preset learning with self-supervised refinement on unpaired photographs. CanonCGT delivers photorealistic and tonally consistent results across diverse datasets, surpassing state-of-the-art methods in stability and visual fidelity. Our codes are available at \href{https://github.com/Jinwon-Ko/CanonCGT}{https://github.com/Jinwon-Ko/CanonCGT}

</details>


### [182] [Edge-directed geometric partitioning for versatile video coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01641)
*Xuewei Meng,Xinfeng Zhang,Chuanmin Jia,Xia Li,Shanshe Wang,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对VVC标准中的几何分区（GEO）技术，提出了一种基于时空边缘信息的MPM列表构建策略，通过减少GEO索引开销提升编码效率，在RA和LDB配置下分别获得0.58%和1.00%的平均BD-rate增益，并改善了物体边界的视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VVC中GEO提供了140种分区候选模式，其最优模式的索引需要显式信令传输，导致较大的开销。为降低索引开销、提升编码效率，需要设计一种高效的GODE模式预测策略。

Method: 利用不同CU的结构特性以及空间相邻块与时域共位块的相关性，提出基于边缘导向的几何分区方案。通过构建最可能模式（MPM）列表，利用时空边缘信息预测最优GEO模式，减少索引信令开销。

Result: 相比VTM-6.0，在RA和LDB配置下平均BD-rate增益分别为0.58%和1.00%，同时改善了物体边界的视觉质量。

Conclusion: 提出的基于时空边缘信息的MPM列表构建策略能有效降低GEO索引开销，提升编码效率，并在主观视觉质量上对物体边界有优化效果。

Abstract: To improve the coding performance, geometric partition (GEO) was proposed for the upcoming VVC standard. GEO provides 140 partition candidates. The index of optimal GEO mode needs to be signaled explicitly. Considering different structural characteristics of different CUs and the correlation between spatial adjacent blocks and temporal collocated blocks, we propose a GEO mode prediction strategy by constructing a Most Probable Mode (MPM) list to reduce the overhead of GEO index and improve coding efficiency. Based on the observation of the high correlation between the partition mode and object boundaries, an edge-directed geometric partition scheme is proposed to construct the MPM list according to spatio-temporal edge information. The proposed method provides an objective BD-rate gain of 0.58% and 1.00% on average for RA and LDB configurations compared to VTM-6.0. Besides, it also promotes the visual quality of object boundaries.

</details>


### [183] [Conditional Collapse in Sign Language Production: A Diagnostic and a Scaling Argument](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01643)
*Rui Hong,Jana Košecká*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有手语生成（SLP）评估指标（FID、BLEU）存在缺陷：指标提升但生成动作不忠实。本文提出三层次评估框架（τ1初始姿态、τ2输出多样性、τ3目标忠实性），通过冻结动作自编码器的潜空间距离比计算。在How2Sign上评估14个模型，发现τ3从未达到，FID与忠实性无相关性。在孤立词数据集ASL3DWord上可达到τ3，表明句子级配对数据规模是瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLP评估指标（FID和BT BLEU）会因动作空间评价偏差而虚高，无法真实反映生成手语动作是否准确传达语义，需要设计更可靠的评估方法。

Method: 提出三层次评估指标（τ1、τ2、τ3），利用冻结的动作自编码器（MoAE）的潜表示计算成对距离比来衡量生成质量。在How2Sign和ASL3DWord数据集上评估14个模型检查点。

Result: 在How2Sign上，所有模型均未达到τ3目标忠实性；FID变化近两个数量级但与忠实性不相关。在ASL3DWord上可达到τ3。

Conclusion: 当前句子级SLP模型缺乏语义忠实性，根本瓶颈在于缺乏大规模句子级配对数据集，而非模型架构。现有评估指标不可靠，需要采用多层次评估。

Abstract: Sign Language Production (SLP) is the task of generating avatar sign language motion from natural language
  text. The quality of the generated motion is typically evaluated by a motion-space Fréchet distance (FID) and
  back-translation (BT) BLEU score on benchmarks such as How2Sign. Both metrics can improve substantially
  while the underlying generator fails to faithfully represent the sign language gestures. In this work we
  propose to evaluate the generated motion at three independent levels: (τ1) initial-pose conditioning, (τ2)
  output diversity, and (τ3) target faithfulness. We compute these as pairwise-distance ratios using latent
  representations of a frozen motion autoencoder (MoAE). We evaluate 14 SLP model checkpoints on the How2Sign
  dataset, including a re-implemented Neural Sign Actors (NSA), and show that τ3 faithfulness is never
  attained, while FID varies by nearly two orders of magnitude and is uncorrelated with faithfulness. We show
  that on the isolated gloss dataset ASL3DWord favorable τ3 can be attained, hence isolating the size of the
  sentence-level paired-dataset as the bottleneck.

</details>


### [184] [PhyScene3D: Physically Consistent Interactive 3D Tabletop Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01649)
*Weixing Chen,Zhuoqian Feng,Yang Liu,Yexin Zhang,Yifan Wen,Yinghong Liao,Weichao Qiu,Guanbin Li,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhyScene3D提出了一种人机模拟构造过程框架，通过认知拓扑推理链(CTRC)和物理感知去噪对齐(PADA)生成物理一致的三维桌面场景，相较于现有方法在语义准确性和物理有效性上均实现最优，场景碰撞率相较于人工标注数据降低40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有三维桌面场景生成方法（如解耦符号求解器和端到端回归模型）存在误差传播或对包含广泛物理违例的噪声监督过拟合的问题，而生成物理一致、可直接加载到物理模拟器的交互式场景对于机器人的交互式和通用学习至关重要，但目前尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出PhyScene3D框架，包含两部分：1) 认知拓扑推理链(CTRC)，将场景合成分解为基于锚点条件的序列化过程，采用3D AABB放置方案施加强结构归纳偏差；2) 物理感知去噪对齐(PADA)，集成可微符号距离场(SDF)与测试时优化(TTO)，将生成场景投影到物理可行流形上同时保留语义意图。

Result: PhyScene3D在语义准确性和物理有效性上均优于现有方法，场景碰撞率相较于人工标注的训练数据降低40%。

Conclusion: 通过将场景生成重构为类人构造过程，并引入物理感知优化对齐机制，PhyScene3D有效解决了物理违例和噪声监督问题，为机器人学习提供了更可靠的物理一致三维场景生成方案。

Abstract: Generating physically consistent 3D tabletop scenes is a fundamental yet underexplored problem for interactive and generalist robotic learning. The challenge stems from dense object hierarchies and irregular affordances. Here, an interactive scene denotes a physically valid, collision-free environment directly loadable into physics simulators. Existing methods, ranging from decoupled symbolic solvers to end-to-end regression models, often suffer from error propagation or overfitting to noisy supervision containing widespread physical violations. To address these limitations, we introduce PhyScene3D, a framework that reformulates generation as a Human-Mimetic Constructive Process. The proposed Cognitive Topological Reasoning Chain (CTRC) factorizes scene synthesis into a sequential, anchor-conditioned process. It employs a 3D AABB-based placement scheme that imposes a strong structural inductive bias. To address imperfect supervision and physical infeasibility, we introduce Physics-Aware Denoising Alignment (PADA). It integrates a differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF) with Test-Time Optimization (TTO) to project generated scenes onto a physics-feasible manifold while preserving semantic intent. Experiments demonstrate that PhyScene3D outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both semantic accuracy and physical validity, achieving a 40% reduction in scene-wise collision rate relative to the human-annotated training data.

</details>


### [185] [Restoring Initial Noise Sensitivity in Text-to-Image Distillation via Geometric Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01651)
*Huayang Huang,Ruoyu Wang,Jinhui Zhao,Wei Deng,Daiguo Zhou,Jian Luan,Yu Wu,Ye Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出几何感知蒸馏（GAD），通过在蒸馏过程中对齐师生模型的输入噪声雅可比-向量积，保留教师模型对初始噪声的敏感性，从而恢复学生模型在噪声驱动控制任务中的表现能力和生成多样性，同时保持高视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式蒸馏方法过度关注效率和保真度，忽略了原始教师轨迹对初始噪声的敏感性这一关键属性，导致下游依赖噪声优化和操控的控制方法性能退化。

Method: 提出GAD框架，通过匹配师生模型关于输入噪声的雅可比-向量积，对齐局部函数行为，在保持点级对齐的同时保留教师模型的局部几何结构和对扰动的微分响应。

Result: 在多种T2I范式和噪声驱动控制任务上的实验表明，GAD显著恢复了对初始噪声的敏感性，提高了生成多样性，同时维持了高视觉保真度。

Conclusion: 生成式蒸馏中保留输入噪声敏感性对于支持下游噪声驱动控制方法至关重要，GAD通过几何感知对齐有效弥补了这一缺失属性。

Abstract: Generative distillation significantly accelerates text-to-image (T2I) generation by compressing multi-step trajectories into few-step student models while preserving perceptual quality. However, existing methods primarily optimize efficiency and output fidelity, often neglecting critical properties of the original trajectory. In this work, we identify a key missing property: sensitivity to initial noise, whose degradation impairs downstream control methods relying on noise-based optimization and manipulation. We trace this issue to standard distillation objectives that enforce pointwise output alignment, inadvertently flattening the input-output landscape and suppressing the teacher's local geometric structure. To address this, we propose Geometry-Aware Distillation (GAD), a sensitivity-preserving framework that aligns the local functional behavior of teacher and student models. Specifically, GAD matches Jacobian-vector products with respect to input noise, enabling the student to reproduce the teacher's differential response to perturbations. Extensive experiments across multiple T2I paradigms and noise-driven control tasks demonstrate that GAD significantly restores sensitivity and improves diversity while maintaining high visual fidelity. Code is available at https://github.com/Hannah1102/GAD.

</details>


### [186] [RPCASSM: Robust PCA State Space Model For Infrared Small Target Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01689)
*Pingping Liu,Aohua Li,Yubing Lu,Jin Kuang,Tongshun Zhang,Qiuzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对红外小目标检测与分割中主流视觉状态空间模型难以准确建模目标边缘的问题，本文基于鲁棒主成分分析(RPCA)范式提出RPCASSM网络，通过设计背景状态空间模块(BSSM)和目标状态空间模块(TSSM)，分别利用空间异质信号显著性和目标稀疏性与局部高亮特性进行状态空间建模，有效解决了边缘结构建模难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外小目标在远距离成像中像素占比低，主流视觉状态空间模型效率低且难以准确建模目标边缘；现有红外状态空间模型未从红外小目标的结构特性出发设计，脱离了对目标本质属性的建模。

Method: 基于RPCA范式设计RPCASSM网络，包含：(1) BSSM模块，利用空间异质信号显著性设计空间探针扫描机制(SPCM)建模背景信息；(2) TSSM模块，利用目标的稀疏性和局部高亮特性设计可变形提示扫描机制(DPCM)，聚焦目标可变形空间进行状态空间建模。

Result: 在现有基准数据集上的实验结果证明了RPCASSM设计的有效性。

Conclusion: RPCASSM通过RPCA启发式的双模块设计（BSSM+TSSM），解决了现有视觉状态空间模型对红外小目标边缘结构建模不精准的问题，为红外小目标检测与分割提供了新范式。

Abstract: The detection and segmentation of infrared small targets have important application significance in the fields of surveillance and security, maritime rescue and so on. Due to the low occupancy of these targets in long-distance imaging, the mainstream visual state space model is inefficient and difficult to accurately model the target edge. The existing infrared state space models do not deviate from the mainstream visual state space structure framework from the structural properties of infrared small targets. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes the RPCASSM network based on the model paradigm of robust principal component analysis(RPCA), which aims to design the background state space module(BSSM) and the target state space module(TSSM) by the nature of the infrared small target in the spatial domain. The BSSM aims to use the saliency of spatial heterogeneous signals to design a spatial probe scanning mechanism(SPCM) to model background information. The TSSM designs a deformable prompt scanning mechanism(DPCM) by using the sparsity and local highlight of the target to focus on the deformable space of the target for state space modeling. According to the above design, we effectively solve the problem that the existing mainstream vision state space model is difficult to accurately model the edge structure of infrared small target. Experimental results on the existing benchmark data sets prove the effectiveness of the RPCASSM design. Our code will be made public at \href{https://github.com/PepperCS/RPCASSM}{RPCASSM}.

</details>


### [187] [Understanding Identity Continuity in Thermal Video through Scene-Level Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01694)
*Wei-Chieh Sun,Gyungmin Ko,Heejae Kwon,Hsiang-Wei Huang,Jenq-Neng Hwang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对热成像行人多目标跟踪中因弱外观线索和频繁检测中断导致的轨迹碎片化问题，提出一种轻量级后处理身份恢复方法。基于YOLOv8+SORT基线，通过在线短间隙重映射和离线轨迹片段重链接模块，在PBVS热成像行人MOT基准上将IDF1从82.25提升至84.93，同时保持MOTA不变。研究表明，在低信息热成像场景下，高精度轨迹重链接比增加跟踪器复杂度更有效地恢复身份连续性，场景级时空一致性起主导作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热成像行人多目标跟踪面临弱外观线索和频繁检测中断导致的严重轨迹碎片化问题，现有方法依赖重识别模型或复杂在线关联策略，计算成本高。作者希望探究轻量级后处理是否能在不依赖繁重重识别模型或复杂在线关联的情况下恢复身份连续性。

Method: 基于YOLOv8检测器和SORT跟踪器构建基线系统，添加模块化身份修复后端，包含：(1) 在线短间隙重映射模块，处理短期轨迹中断；(2) 离线轨迹片段重链接模块，利用时域、空域、运动域和边界线索进行轨迹关联。采用控制变量法在固定验证集上进行消融实验。

Result: 在PBVS热成像行人MOT基准上，IDF1从82.25提升至84.93，MOTA保持不变。主要身份增益来自保守的重链接策略，多数启发式阈值在广泛操作范围内保持稳定。

Conclusion: 在低信息热成像场景下，高精度轨迹重链接比增加跟踪器复杂度更有效地恢复身份连续性，场景级时空一致性在身份连续性中起主导作用，而非局部帧间关联。

Abstract: Thermal pedestrian MOT remains challenging because weak appearance cues and frequent detection interruptions cause severe trajectory fragmentation. We study whether lightweight post-processing can recover identity continuity without relying on heavy re-identification models or complex online association. Starting from a YOLOv8 and SORT baseline, we add a modular identity-repair backend consisting of online short-gap remapping and offline tracklet relinking based on temporal, spatial, motion, and border cues. Controlled ablations on a fixed validation split and evaluation on the official PBVS Thermal Pedestrian MOT benchmark show that the main identity gains arise from conservative relinking, improving IDF1 from 82.25 to 84.93 while preserving MOTA, whereas many heuristic thresholds remain stable across broad operating ranges. These results suggest that, in low-information thermal imagery, robust identity recovery can be achieved more effectively through high-precision trajectory relinking than through increasing tracker complexity. These results provide a controlled analysis of identity recovery in thermal video, showing that scene-level spatial-temporal consistency plays a dominant role in identity continuity compared to local frame-to-frame association.

</details>


### [188] [Learning Label-Efficient Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis via Semi-supervised Hypergraph Concept Bottleneck Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01698)
*Yijun Yang,Ruiqiang Xiao,Lijie Hu,Angelica I Aviles-Rivero,Yunzhu Wu,Jing Qin,Lei Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种半监督的概念瓶颈模型框架HyperCBM，通过双层超图学习建模概念间高阶依赖关系并生成领域自适应伪标签，在PAS超声、乳腺超声和皮肤镜数据集上实现了高解释性和诊断性能，同时降低了对专家概念标注的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在医学图像分析中诊断精度高但缺乏可解释性，阻碍了临床采纳。概念瓶颈模型（CBM）虽能嵌入临床可解释的中间概念，但传统CBM难以捕捉概念间复杂依赖关系，且需要昂贵的专家标注概念，可扩展性有限。

Method: 提出半监督CBM框架HyperCBM，利用双层超图学习：概念级超图用于增强推理（建模高阶概念依赖），图像级超图用于生成鲁棒的领域自适应伪标签，实现对概念标注的高效利用。

Result: 在新标注的PAS超声数据集、乳腺超声公开数据集以及皮肤镜数据集SkinCon上验证了有效性，实现了优越的解释性和诊断性能。

Conclusion: 该半监督CBM框架通过超图建模概念依赖和伪标签生成，在减少概念标注成本的同时保持了高性能和可解释性，是一种有前景的医学影像可解释诊断方法。

Abstract: Deep learning has revolutionized medical image analysis, delivering exceptional diagnostic accuracy across diverse applications. Yet, the lack of interpretability in its decision-making hinders clinical adoption, particularly in high-stakes medical contexts where transparency is paramount for trustworthiness. For example, in Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), subtle cues in ultrasound imaging challenge reliable diagnosis, rendering black-box models untrustworthy for accurate scoring. To address this, Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) offer a promising avenue by embedding clinically meaningful intermediate concepts into the diagnosis pipeline, enabling clinicians to scrutinize and refine model outputs. However, conventional CBMs falter in capturing complex inter-concept dependencies and demand costly, expert-driven concept annotations, limiting their scalability. This study introduces a novel semi-supervised CBM framework designed for medical imaging, which leverages dual-level hypergraph learning to model high-order concept dependencies and generate domain-adaptive pseudo-labels. Our approach achieves superior interpretability and performance by integrating a concept-level hypergraph for enhanced reasoning and an image-level hypergraph for robust pseudo-label generation. Experiments on a newly annotated PAS ultrasound dataset and a breast ultrasound public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed concept label-efficient interpretable framework. Its universality is further validated on the dermoscopic image dataset SkinCon. The code is available at https://github.com/scott-yjyang/HyperCBM.

</details>


### [189] [MixerSENet: A Lightweight Framework for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01700)
*Mohammed Q. Alkhatib,Swalpa Kumar Roy,Ali Jamali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种轻量级高光谱图像分类框架MixerSENet，通过解耦空间与通道维度混合并引入SENet模块，在Houston13和Qingyun数据集上分别取得82.47%和96.70%的总体精度，仅需53,146个参数，在计算效率和分类性能之间取得了良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高光谱图像分类方法面临计算效率低下和标注数据有限两大挑战，传统模型参数量大、计算成本高，难以在资源受限环境中部署。

Method: MixerSENet采用一致尺寸和分辨率处理高光谱图像块，解耦空间与通道维度的混合过程；引入SENet模块进行特征精炼，增强网络捕获信息特征的能力；整体架构轻量化，参数量少。

Result: 在Houston13数据集上OA达82.47%，Qingyun数据集上OA达96.70%，优于3D-CNN、HybridKAN、HSIFormer、SimPoolFormer和MorphMamba等方法；模型仅含53,146个参数，推理时间短。

Conclusion: MixerSENet在准确率与效率之间取得了有利平衡，验证了其在实际应用中的实用性，代码将开源。

Abstract: In this paper, a novel framework, MixerSENet, is introduced for hyperspectral image (HSI) classification, designed to address the challenges of computational efficiency and limited labeled data. The proposed model processes hyperspectral image patches while maintaining consistent size and resolution throughout the network, effectively decoupling the mixing of spatial and channel dimensions. Notably, MixerSENet is lightweight and computationally efficient, requiring fewer parameters compared to traditional models, making it suitable for resource-constrained environments. A squeeze and excitation block is incorporated into the model to refine feature extraction, enhancing the network's ability to capture more informative features. Experimental results on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that MixerSENet achieves superior performance, reaching an overall accuracy (OA) of 82.47% on Houston13 dataset and 96.70% on the Qingyun dataset, outperforming state-of-the-art methods including 3D-CNN, HybridKAN, HSIFormer, SimPoolFormer, and MorphMamba. Furthermore, a detailed analysis of computational efficiency shows that MixerSENet achieves a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency, with only 53,146 parameters and an low inference time, confirming its practicality for real-world applications. At publication, source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/mqalkhatib/MixerSENet.

</details>


### [190] [Spatio-Temporal Correlation Guided Geometric Partitioning for Versatile Video Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01701)
*Xuewei Meng,Chuanmin Jia,Xinfeng Zhang,Shanshe Wang,Siwei Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于时空相关性引导的几何划分（STGEO）方案，通过利用时空相关性预测高概率的划分模式和运动候选，减少边信息开销，在VVC框架下实现平均0.95%~1.98%的码率节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VVC中现有几何划分（GEO）方案在编码边信息（包括划分模式和运动信息）时产生了不可忽略的开销，限制了编码效率的提升。

Method: 首先从统计角度分析划分模式决策和运动矢量选择的特性，利用观察到的时空相关性设计模式预测和编码方法：基于边缘信息和相邻STGEO编码块的历史模式预测高概率STGEO模式；基于离线训练的合并候选选择概率自适应推断运动信息索引。

Result: 与不含GEO的VTM-8.0相比，Random Access配置下平均节省0.95%码率，Low-Delay B配置下平均节省1.98%码率。

Conclusion: 所提出的STGEO方案能够有效减少几何划分边信息的编码开销，提升混合视频编码框架的编码效率。

Abstract: Geometric partitioning has attracted increasing attention by its remarkable motion field description capability in the hybrid video coding framework. However, the existing geometric partitioning (GEO) scheme in Versatile Video Coding (VVC) causes a non-negligible burden for signaling the side information. Consequently, the coding efficiency is limited. In view of this, we propose a spatio-temporal correlation guided geometric partitioning (STGEO) scheme to efficiently describe the object information in the motion field of video coding. The proposed method can economize the bits consumed for side information signaling, including the partitioning mode and motion information. We firstly analyze the characteristics of partitioning mode decision and motion vector selection in a statistically-sound way. Based on the observed spatio-temporal correlation, we design a mode prediction and coding method to reduce the overhead for representing the above mentioned side information. The main idea is to predict the STGEO modes and motion candidates that have higher selection possibilities, which can guide the entropy coding, i.e., representing the predicted high-probability modes and motion candidates with fewer bits. In particular, the high-probability STGEO modes are predicted based on the edge information and history modes of adjacent STGEO-coded blocks. The corresponding motion information is represented by the index in a merge candidate list, which is adaptively inferred based on the off-line trained merge candidate selection probability. Simulation results show that the proposed approach achieves 0.95% and 1.98% bit-rate savings on average compared to VTM-8.0 without GEO for Random Access and Low-Delay B configurations, respectively.

</details>


### [191] [Density-Aware Translation of Spurious Correlations in Zero-Shot VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01710)
*Afsaneh Hasanebrahimi,Hanxun Huang,Christopher Leckie,Sarah Erfani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出密度感知平移（DAT）方法，利用局部几何密度项修正CLIP的图像-文本相似度分数，以抑制虚假相关性并提升零样本分类的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP等VLM在零样本分类中容易受到虚假相关性的影响（上下文信息主导语义内容），现有微调方法损害预训练优势，提示工程易产生幻觉。

Method: 利用CLIP嵌入的模态间隙和各向异性壳分布特性（常见模式靠近均值，稀有模式被推向外围），基于组参考集计算局部几何密度，通过密度感知的相对度量重新缩放相似度分数，抑制稀疏区域的过置信分数，保留密集的语义一致匹配。

Result: 在基准数据集上一致提升了最差组准确率和平均准确率。

Conclusion: 密度感知平移是一种简单有效的校准机制，可用于多模态模型的可靠零样本分类。

Abstract: Vision-Language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, achieve powerful zero-shot classification. However, their predictions remain sensitive to spurious correlations, where contextual cues dominate over semantic content. Earlier solutions typically rely on fine-tuning or prompt engineering, which either undermine the advantages of pre-trained models or are prone to hallucination. In this work, we propose Density-Aware Translation (DAT) that refines image-text similarity scores using a local geometric density term derived from group reference sets. Our approach is motivated by the phenomenon that CLIP embeddings exhibit a modality gap and lie on an anisotropic shell in the feature space: common patterns cluster near the mean, while rare patterns are pushed outward. This geometry creates uneven alignment, where spurious correlations are amplified while semantically meaningful but rare cues are marginalised. To address this, we employ a relative measure to rescale similarities based on embedding density, suppressing overconfident scores in diffuse regions while preserving dense, semantically consistent matches. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in worst-group and average accuracy, highlighting density-aware translation as a simple and effective calibration mechanism for reliable zero-shot classification using multimodal models.

</details>


### [192] [Improving Visual Token Reduction via Rectifying Distortions for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01711)
*Hyeonwoo Cho,DongHyeon Baek,Yewon Kim,Bumsub Ham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RESTORE提出了一种新的视觉标记缩减框架，通过校准位置和注意力失真，在保持计算效率的同时提升多模态大语言模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉标记缩减方法忽略了完整序列与缩减序列之间的位置和注意力一致性，导致表征失真，迫切需要一种既能减少计算开销又能保持表征质量的方法。

Method: 提出RESTORE框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于相对距离的注意力权重增强方法，用于恢复丢失的视觉注意力；(2) 独特的锚点选择策略用于标记合并，以减轻特征平均过程中的信息损失。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，RESTORE一致提升了各种缩减方法的准确率，实现了最先进的性能，同时保持了计算效率。

Conclusion: 通过校准位置和注意力失真，RESTORE有效解决了视觉标记缩减带来的表征问题，为高效多模态大语言模型提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in vision-language tasks, yet the quadratic computational complexity arising from the vast number of visual tokens incurs significant memory and latency bottlenecks. While visual token reduction (VTR) strategies have been explored to mitigate this burden, existing methods overlook the positional and attentional consistency between the full and reduced sequences, resulting in a distorted representation. To this end, we propose RESTORE, a novel VTR framework that rectifies the positional and attentional distortions while maintaining efficiency. Specifically, we present a simple yet effective calibration method that restores lost visual attention by augmenting attention weights based on relative distances. We also introduce a distinctive anchor selection for token merging to mitigate information loss during feature averaging. Experimental results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves the accuracy of various reduction methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while maintaining computational efficiency.

</details>


### [193] [FlatVPR: Plug-and-play Geo-linear Residual Adapter for Geometric Rectification of Foundation Model Feature Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01734)
*Rai Hisada,Kanji Tanaka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlatVPR提出了一种几何校正范式，通过线性插值重建特征描述子，并引入残差适配器和Pullback Flatness Loss来抑制流形曲率，在极稀疏锚点条件下实现地图轻量化与定位精度之间的有效平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VPR方法中，地图轻量化与定位精度之间存在矛盾；虽然后端基础模型（如DINOv2-ViT-S/14）提供了鲁棒的语义特征，但其潜在流形存在显著曲率，导致物理空间中的均匀线性运动映射到特征空间中的高度非线性轨迹，阻碍了稀疏锚点条件下的可靠重建。

Method: 提出FlatVPR范式，核心包括：(1) 在原始基础特征上添加可学习的残差适配器 $\hat{\mathbf{z}} = \mathbf{z} + \text{Res}(\mathbf{z})$；(2) 提出Pullback Flatness Loss，通过最小化中间特征与相邻锚点间线性段的偏差来显式抑制流形曲率；(3) 将地图构建置于EM框架中，解耦为连续M步（流形适应）和概念E步（最优锚点选择）。

Result: 在NCLT数据集上的实验表明，即使锚点间隔达100m且存在极端季节变化，该方法仍能取得显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过空间展平操作，有效桥接了地图轻量化与定位精度之间的权衡，为稀疏锚点条件下的VPR提供了新思路。

Abstract: This paper proposes ``FlatVPR,'' a novel geometric rectification paradigm that effectively bridges the trade-off between map lightweightness and localization accuracy in visual place recognition (VPR) by enforcing a feature manifold structure where any descriptor between two adjacent anchors $\mathbf{z}_A$ and $\mathbf{z}_B$ can be accurately reconstructed via linear interpolation $\hat{\mathbf{z}}_{pseudo} = (1-t)\mathbf{z}_A + t\mathbf{z}_B$, where $t \in [0,1]$ denotes the relative position. While state-of-the-art foundation models such as DINOv2-ViT-S/14 provide robust semantic features, their latent manifolds exhibit prominent curvature, projecting uniform linear motion in physical space onto highly non-linear trajectories in the feature space, which hinders reliable reconstruction under sparse anchor conditions. To enable the aforementioned interpolation-based reconstruction, we introduce a residual transformation $\hat{\mathbf{z}} = \mathbf{z} + \text{Res}(\mathbf{z})$ to the raw foundation features $\mathbf{z}$, where $\text{Res}(\cdot)$ represents a learnable adapter. Our method explicitly suppresses manifold curvature using a mathematically grounded Pullback Flatness Loss that minimizes the deviation of intermediate features from the linear segment connecting adjacent anchors, thereby minimizing the intrinsic curvature of the manifold. Through this spatial flattening, map construction is formulated within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) framework, decoupled into a continuous M-step for manifold adaptation and a conceptual E-step for optimal anchor selection guidelines. Experiments on the NCLT dataset demonstrate that the application of our adapter leads to significant performance improvements even under extremely sparse anchor conditions with 100m intervals and extreme seasonal changes.

</details>


### [194] [Sensitivity as a Double-Edged Sword: A Trade-off Between Discriminability and Adversarial Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01746)
*Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现全连接分类器的高敏感性是神经网络易受对抗攻击的原因之一，而ℓ2距离分类器更具鲁棒性。为此提出基于混合原型混合（HPM）框架的ℓ2重分类器，融合稳定数据集级原型和动态批量级原型，兼顾判别力与鲁棒性。同时提出混合代理攻击（MSA）评估协议解决评估难题。实验表明该轻量即插即用模块可有效增强现有对抗训练模型的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示全连接分类器的高敏感性是神经网络对抗脆弱性的重要来源，并探索在保持判别力的同时提升鲁棒性的方法。

Method: 提出HPM框架，融合EMA更新的稳定数据集级原型和通过STE从FC分类器预测生成的动态批量级原型，实现ℓ2距离预测。同时提出MSA评估协议，使用多个代理模型和AutoAttack解决梯度混淆和前向不连续问题。

Result: 轻量即插即用的ℓ2重分类器经过少量微调即可有效增强多种现有SOTA对抗训练模型的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FC分类器的高敏感性与ℓ2分类器的低敏感性存在根本性权衡，所提方法可在保留FC判别力的同时获得ℓ2的鲁棒性，且评估协议保障了公平性。

Abstract: Modern neural networks are highly susceptible to adversarial perturbations. In this work, we identify that part of this vulnerability stems from the sensitivity of the widely used fully connected (FC) classifiers to such perturbations. In contrast, simple $\ell_2$ distance-based classifiers exhibit significantly greater robustness. We provide thorough theoretical and empirical analysis showing that while FC classifiers' high sensitivity makes them discriminative, it also makes them vulnerable. Conversely, $\ell_2$-classifiers' insensitivity grants robustness but limits performance. Motivated by this trade-off, we propose a novel $\ell_2$-reclassifier based on a Hybrid Prototype Mixing (HPM) framework. This method retains the discriminative power of FC classifiers while leveraging the robustness of $\ell_2$ distance. It yields $\ell_2$-distance-based predictions by fusing two prototype types: (1) stable, dataset-level prototypes updated via EMA, and (2) dynamic, batch-level prototypes generated from the FC classifier's predictions using a Straight-Through Estimator (STE). However, this dynamic, STE-based architecture introduces significant challenges for evaluation, such as gradient obfuscation and forward discontinuity. To address this, we propose a new, rigorous evaluation protocol, the Mixed Surrogate Attack (MSA), which uses multiple surrogates along with powerful AutoAttack to ensure a fair and robust assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our lightweight, plug-and-play module, with minimal fine-tuning, effectively enhances the adversarial robustness of various existing SOTA adversarially trained models.

</details>


### [195] [Quality-Guided Semi-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01753)
*Kumar Abhishek,Ghassan Hamarneh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种质量引导的半监督学习框架，通过专用网络估计分割质量，实现更可靠的伪标签利用，在多个医学图像分割数据集上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有半监督学习方法依赖模型置信度或不确定性来评估伪标签可靠性，但这些指标是自我参照的，缺乏对分割质量明确的衡量标准。

Method: 1) 训练专用质量预测网络，从图像-掩膜对中估计分割质量；2) 通过合成退化及部分训练分割模型的不完美输出生成变质量掩膜，训练预测器；3) 提出质量感知正则化损失和基于质量的伪标签样本重加权两种互补机制。

Result: 在五个数据集和多种架构上的实验表明，该方法可作为现有半监督框架的即插即用增强模块，持续优于竞争方法，达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 质量引导的伪标签评估策略有效克服了传统自我参照指标的局限性，显著提升了半监督医学图像分割性能。

Abstract: Training accurate medical image segmentation models requires large amounts of densely annotated data, which is costly and time-consuming to obtain. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) alleviates this by learning from both abundant unlabeled data and limited labeled data. However, most modern SSL methods rely on pseudolabels for unlabeled data, and typically assess their reliability through model confidence or uncertainty, measures that are self-referential and lack explicit grounding in segmentation quality. Instead, we propose a quality-guided SSL framework that trains a dedicated network to estimate segmentation quality from image-mask pairs. The predictor is trained on variable-quality masks generated through synthetic corruptions augmented with imperfect outputs from partially trained segmentation models, capturing realistic error patterns encountered during training. We integrate the quality predictor into SSL through two complementary mechanisms: a quality-aware regularization loss and a quality-based pseudolabel sample reweighting scheme. We show that our method serves as a drop-in enhancement to existing SSL frameworks. Extensive experiments across five datasets and multiple architectures demonstrate consistent improvements over competing SSL methods, advancing the state-of-the-art in semi-supervised medical image segmentation.

</details>


### [196] [EvoCut: Multi-Layer Evolution-Aware Visual Token Compression for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01756)
*Hongyu Lu,Feng Zhang,Wenwei Jin,Huanling Hu,Pengfei Zhang,Yao Hu,Jiawei Li,Shikai Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对LVLM视觉编码器生成大量视觉token导致推理效率低下的问题，本文提出EvoCut方法，通过分析视觉token在多层的演化方向，发现信息性token会持续偏离共同演化方向，据此实现无需训练和注意力机制的高效token压缩，仅保留11.1%的token即可保持94.4%的平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法仅基于单层注意力分数或表征属性评估token重要性，忽略了token在视觉编码器各层之间的演化过程，导致重要性估计不完整，压缩后性能损失较大。

Method: EvoCut：一种无需训练、无需注意力的视觉token压缩方法。首先分析视觉token在编码器各层的演化方向，发现token会形成多个群体演化方向；观察到信息性token会持续偏离这些共同演化方向；据此通过多层演化偏差来估计token重要性，保留偏差大的token。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，仅保留11.1%的视觉token即可保持94.4%的平均性能，展现了压缩效率与性能保持之间的良好平衡。

Conclusion: EvoCut通过捕捉token跨层演化的动态特性而非静态单层信息，能更准确地评估token重要性，是一种高效的视觉token压缩方案。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance on image and video understanding tasks, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by vision encoders. Most existing visual token compression methods estimate token importance from attention scores or representation properties at specific layers, overlooking how visual tokens evolve across the vision encoder. Such layer-specific criteria may provide incomplete importance estimates and limit performance preservation after compression. To address this issue, we analyze layer-wise visual token evolution directions and observe that tokens form multiple group evolution directions across vision-encoder layers. Our analysis further shows that informative tokens tend to exhibit persistent deviations from common group evolution directions. Based on this observation, we propose EvoCut, a training-free and attention-free visual token compression method that estimates token importance from multi-layer evolution deviation. Experimental results show that EvoCut can retain only 11.1\% of the visual tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B while preserving 94.4\% of the average performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in balancing efficiency and accuracy.

</details>


### [197] [PillarDETR: YOLO-Backbone and RT-DETR Head for Real-Time 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01757)
*Smit Kadvani,Shriya Gumber,Kriti Faujdar,Harsh Dave*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PillarDETR是一种结合柱状LiDAR编码、YOLOv8的CSP骨干网络和RT-DETR解码器的端到端3D目标检测架构，在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上实现了精度与推理速度的良好平衡，且无需NMS后处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于3D卷积或锚点机制的3D目标检测方法难以在检测精度与推理速度之间取得平衡，亟需一种高效且准确的实时3D检测方案。

Method: 1) 采用柱状(pillar)方式编码LiDAR点云生成伪图像；2) 使用YOLOv8的Cross Stage Partial (CSP)网络作为骨干提取特征；3) 引入Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR)解码器替代传统锚点/中心检测头，实现端到端预测，无需非极大值抑制(NMS)。

Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，PillarDETR在mAP与推理延迟之间取得了有竞争力的平衡；消融实验表明YOLOv8骨干与RT-DETR头相比PointPillars基线带来显著提升。

Conclusion: PillarDETR被证明是一种高效且有效的实时3D感知解决方案，通过混合架构设计成功实现了精度与速度的良好权衡。

Abstract: Real-time 3D object detection is a critical component for the safe operation of autonomous driving systems and robotics. While LiDAR point clouds provide accurate spatial information, processing them efficiently remains a significant challenge. Traditional methods rely on complex 3D convolutions or anchor-based paradigms that struggle to balance detection accuracy with inference speed. In this paper, we propose PillarDETR, a novel end-to-end 3D object detection architecture that combines the efficiency of pillar-based LiDAR encoding with the representational power of modern 2D vision models. Specifically, PillarDETR replaces standard convolutional backbones with a Cross Stage Partial (CSP) network derived from YOLOv8, enabling richer feature extraction from pseudoimages. Furthermore, we discard conventional anchor-based or center-based detection heads in favor of a Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR) decoder. This hybrid design allows the network to capture global context and directly predict 3D bounding boxes without relying on non-maximum suppression (NMS). Extensive experiments on the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that PillarDETR achieves a compelling trade-off between mean Average Precision (mAP) and inference latency. Our ablation studies confirm that integrating the YOLOv8 backbone and RT-DETR head yields substantial improvements over the PointPillars baseline, establishing PillarDETR as a highly effective solution for real-time 3D perception.

</details>


### [198] [PlatonicNav: Unveiling Semantic Correspondence in Navigation with Platonic Topological Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01788)
*Junlin Long,Zeyu Zhang,Xu Deng,Yiran Wang,Yue Yang,Luke Borgnolo,Maxwell Twelftree,Yang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PlatonicNav，一种无需训练的导航框架，通过扩展柏拉图表示假说到具身导航，将视觉-only ObjNav、跨模态ObjNav和VLN统一为同一目标中心语义流形的不同接口。该方法利用自监督视觉编码器构建柏拉图拓扑图，在不使用任何配对视觉-语言数据的情况下实现语言目标的地面化，在多个仿真基准和真实机器人上取得良好泛化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN和ObjNav的统一方法停留在架构融合、混合任务训练和大规模视觉-语言预训练层面，未探究独立训练的视觉和语言编码器是否已共享共同语义结构；且目标中心拓扑图仍依赖CLIP等显式跨模态监督进行语言目标地面化，不清楚纯视觉构建的地图是否能实现这一目标。

Method: 提出PlatonicNav框架，其核心是柏拉图拓扑图，融合自监督视觉编码器提取的几何和语义节点距离；通过盲匹配实现语言目标地面化，无需任何配对视觉-语言数据。将三类导航任务重解释为同一目标中心语义流形的不同接口。

Result: 在HM3D-IIN、OVON和R2R-CE (MP3D)等仿真基准以及Unitree Go2真实机器人上，PlatonicNav展现了跨任务、跨模态、跨具身的泛化能力，无需显式跨模态训练。

Conclusion: 柏拉图表示假说可有效扩展到具身导航领域，纯视觉构建的拓扑图足以实现跨模态语言目标地面化，为统一不同导航任务提供了新范式。

Abstract: Embodied visual navigation, where an agent perceives a complex environment and acts to reach a goal from raw sensory input, underpins a wide range of applications such as household service robotics, assistive robotics, and large-scale autonomous exploration. However, recent attempts to unify vision-and-language navigation (VLN) and object goal navigation (ObjNav) remain at the level of architectural fusion, mixed-task training, and large vision-language pretraining, without examining whether independently trained vision and language encoders may already share a common semantic structure. Moreover, even object-centric topological maps still ground language goals through explicit cross-modal supervision such as CLIP or large vision-language models, leaving open whether such grounding is possible from a purely vision-built map. To address these challenges, we extend the Platonic Representation Hypothesis to embodied navigation and recast vision-only ObjNav, cross-modal ObjNav, and VLN as three different interfaces to the same object-centric semantic manifold. We further introduce PlatonicNav, a training-free framework whose Platonic Topological Map fuses geometric and semantic node distances from a self-supervised visual encoder, and grounds language goals via blind matching without any paired vision-language data. Extensive experiments on simulation benchmarks including HM3D-IIN, OVON, and R2R-CE on MP3D, together with deployment on Unitree Go2, demonstrate that PlatonicNav generalizes across tasks, modalities, and embodiments without explicit cross-modal training. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/PlatonicNav. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/PlatonicNav.

</details>


### [199] [STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01790)
*Yuhang Han,Wenzheng Yang,Yujie Chen,Xiangqi Jin,Yaojie Zhang,Siteng Huang,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STaR-KV，一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩框架，通过子空间感知评分、时间稳定性折扣和熵驱动温度自适应重塑令牌重要性，在GUI代理任务中以20%的KV缓存预算将峰值GPU内存降低近40%，且无额外计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM-based GUI代理中，KV缓存随交互步骤线性增长，导致显存瓶颈（如UI-TARS-1.5-7B处理5张截图即消耗76GB显存）。现有KV压缩方法存在两个错误的结构性假设：将视觉令牌重要性聚合为单一共享显著性图，以及应用固定top-B截断。实验表明视觉注意力存在子空间级空间特化且跨层迁移，得分分布沿轨迹漂移，亟需更精细的自适应压缩方法。

Method: STaR-KV沿三个维度校准令牌重要性：(i) 子空间感知评分——基于在线空间互信息；(ii) 时间稳定性折扣——抑制持续被关注子空间中的冗余缓存条目；(iii) 熵驱动温度——自适应重塑得分分布。框架无需训练。

Result: 在四个GUI基准测试中，STaR-KV在匹配预算下达到最强平均准确率（超越GUIKV、SnapKV等）；压缩阶段FLOPs开销为-0.07%（几乎为零）；在20% KV缓存预算下将峰值GPU内存降低近40%。

Conclusion: STaR-KV通过打破传统压缩方法的两个错误假设，实现了高效且无额外计算成本的KV缓存压缩，显著降低了GUI代理的部署门槛。

Abstract: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and applying a fixed top-B cutoff to the fused score distribution. Pilot measurements refute both: spatial specialization lives at the attention-subspace level and migrates across layers, while the score distribution drifts in shape along a trajectory. We propose STaR-KV (Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting), a training-free KV cache compression framework that calibrates token importance along three axes: (i) subspace-aware scoring driven by online spatial mutual information; (ii) a temporal stability discount that suppresses redundant cache entries from persistently attended subspaces; and (iii) an entropy-derived temperature that adaptively reshapes the score distribution. Across four GUI benchmarks, STaR-KV achieves the strongest average accuracy among state-of-the-art KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV) at matched budgets, with no compression-stage FLOPs overhead (-0.07%) and cutting peak GPU memory by nearly 40% at a 20% KV-cache budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kawhiiiileo/STaR-KV.

</details>


### [200] [Personalized 3D Myocardial Infarct Geometry Reconstruction from Cine MRI for Cardiac Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01808)
*Yilin Lyu,Mark YY Chan,Ching-Hui Sia,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种显式几何-运动嵌入模型，从无对比剂的多视角电影MRI中全自动重建个性化、可仿真的3D心肌梗死几何结构，用于心脏数字孪生建模。该方法通过4D双心室网格提取几何和运动特征，设计双分支模块实现自适应融合，并利用AHA-17节段引导的交叉注意力机制进行多尺度监督。在225例数据上Dice达0.678，下游电生理仿真与LGE金标准高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LGE MRI依赖对比剂，不适用于肾功能不全患者且难以长期随访。无对比剂的电影MRI可观测异常室壁运动但缺乏直接重建3D梗死几何的方法，亟需一种能从电影MRI中自动、准确地重建可用于心脏数字孪生仿真的梗死几何结构的技术。

Method: 1) 构建4D (3D+t) 双心室网格，显式提取和解耦几何感知与运动感知特征；2) 设计双分支模块实现几何-运动自适应融合，捕捉时空依赖关系以映射梗死区域；3) 引入AHA-17节段引导的交叉注意力多尺度监督，确保生物物理一致的重建。

Result: 在225例电影MRI上，3D梗死重建的平均Dice为0.678±0.011。下游电生理仿真评估中，结果与LGE-derived金标准高度一致，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该模型能够从无对比剂电影MRI中实现高质量3D梗死几何重建，有望替代LGE MRI用于心脏数字孪生建模中的瘢痕表征，尤其适用于肾功能不全患者和长期随访场景。

Abstract: Accurate 3D geometric characterization of myocardial infarction (MI) is essential for building cardiac digital twins (CDTs) to precisely simulate infarct-related electrophysiology. Late gadolinium enhancement magnetic resonance imaging (LGE MRI) is the clinical reference for locating MI, yet its reliance on contrast agents restricts use in renally impaired patients and limits longitudinal follow-ups. As an alternative, contrast-free cine MRI visualizes abnormal ventricular wall motion, which is highly indicative of the infarcted area. In this study, we propose a novel explicit geometry-motion embedded model to fully automatically reconstruct personalized, simulation-ready 3D MI geometries directly from multi-view cine MRIs. Specifically, we construct a 4D (3D + t) biventricular mesh to explicitly extract and decouple geometry-aware and motion-aware features. We further design a dual-branch module for adaptive geometry-motion fusion to capture spatiotemporal dependencies for mapping infarcted region. Furthermore, we introduce multi-scale supervision utilizing an AHA-17 segment-guided cross-attention mechanism to steer the prediction, ensuring biophysically consistent reconstruction. Experimental results on 225 cine MRIs demonstrated that the proposed 3D MI reconstruction achieved high performance with an average Dice score of 0.678 $\pm$ 0.011. In the downstream in-silico electrophysiological simulation evaluations, the results were highly consistent with the LGE-derived ground truth, highlighting the great potential of the proposed model for contrast-free scar characterization and seamless integration into CDT modeling. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.

</details>


### [201] [Unsupervised Collaborative Domain Adaptation for Driving Scene Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01818)
*Jiahe Fan,Shaolong Shu,Mingjian Sun,Tiehua Zhang,Bohong Xiao,Hanli Wang,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无监督协作域适应（UCDA）框架，用于在无源数据条件下实现多源预训练模型的协同知识迁移，提升自动驾驶场景解析的可靠性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无源无监督域适应方法依赖单一预训练源模型，导致感知系统易受源特定偏差影响，在多变驾驶环境（道路布局、光照、天气、交通状况）下鲁棒性不足。同时，像素级标注成本高且源数据常因隐私、安全或所有权限制不可用。

Method: UCDA包含三个关键组件：1) 构建类级原型记忆库，通过原型相似度估计跨模型预测可靠性，缓解不同源模型置信度尺度不一致问题；2) 两阶段迁移策略：先通过正负一致性约束对多个源模型进行协同优化，再将其验证的专家知识蒸馏至单一可部署目标模型。

Result: 在公开驾驶场景数据集和真实自动驾驶平台数据上的综合评估表明，UCDA有效整合了互补的多源知识，提升了目标域场景解析的可靠性和跨不同驾驶环境的泛化能力。

Conclusion: UCDA通过多源协作与知识蒸馏，在不访问原始源数据的情况下，成功实现了鲁棒的驾驶场景解析域适应，为自动驾驶感知系统在开放动态环境中的部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Reliable driving scene parsing is a fundamental capability for autonomous vehicles operating in open and dynamic driving environments. However, adapting perception models to new deployment domains remains challenging because pixel-level annotations are expensive to obtain, while source-domain data are often inaccessible due to privacy, security, or ownership constraints. Existing source-free unsupervised domain adaptation methods typically rely on a single pre-trained source model, which makes the adapted perception system vulnerable to source-specific biases and limits its robustness under diverse road layouts, illumination conditions, weather patterns, and traffic conditions. This article presents an unsupervised collaborative domain adaptation (UCDA) framework for driving scene parsing in a source-free setting, which transfers complementary knowledge from multiple pre-trained source models to a unified target model without accessing any original source samples. To compare predictions from independently trained models, UCDA constructs a class-level prototype memory bank and estimates cross-model prediction reliability through prototype similarity, reducing the effect of inconsistent confidence scales across source models. Based on the resulting complementary supervision, UCDA adopts a two-stage transfer strategy: multiple source models are first refined on unlabeled target-domain driving data through collaborative optimization with positive and negative consistency constraints, and their validated expertise is then distilled into a single deployable target model. Comprehensive evaluations on public driving-scene datasets and real-world data collected from an autonomous vehicle platform demonstrate that UCDA effectively consolidates complementary multi-source knowledge, improving target-domain scene parsing reliability and generalization across diverse driving environments.

</details>


### [202] [Hist2Style: Histogram-Guided Stylization with Bilateral Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01819)
*Dekel Galor,Adam Pikielny,Zhoutong Zhang,Ke Wang,Laura Waller,Jiawen Chen,Ilya Chugunov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hist2Style提出了一种基于双边网格的快速、边缘感知的逼真风格迁移方法，通过蒸馏大图像编辑模型为轻量网络，结合直方图风格嵌入，实现了实时、高分辨率、用户可控的色彩和色调调整，同时避免幻觉并保持内容结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型图像模型虽能实现外观编辑，但存在高计算需求、幻觉风险以及用户控制有限的问题，无法满足高分辨率实时工作流的需求。

Method: 采用双边网格公式进行快速边缘感知风格化，将操作约束为双边空间中的局部仿射变换；通过在大规模监督语料上训练（该语料由语言模型和视觉-语言模型生成），将大图像编辑模型蒸馏为轻量网络；网络以基于直方图的风格目标嵌入为条件，提供可解释的用户接口。

Result: 该方法能通过构造保持内容结构、避免幻觉，并支持实时、高分辨率的逼真风格迁移，且允许用户交互式控制色彩和色调调整。

Conclusion: Hist2Style在保持视觉保真度的同时，实现了高效、可控的逼真风格迁移，适合高分辨率实时工作流。

Abstract: Photorealistic style transfer aims to match the color and tone of an input image to that of a style target while preserving the content and details of the original scene. Although existing large image models can facilitate these kinds of appearance edits, their high computational demands, potential for hallucinations, and limited user control make them unsuitable for high-resolution, real-time workflows. We introduce Hist2Style, a bilateral-grid formulation for fast, edge-aware stylization that preserves visual fidelity by constraining operations to locally affine transforms in bilateral space. Our model distills a large image editing model into a lightweight network by training on a large supervised corpus generated with language and vision-language models, targeting spatially varying color edits. The network conditions on a histogram-based embedding of the style target to provide an interpretable interface for adjusting the output style by modifying the target color distribution. Overall, Hist2Style maintains content structure by construction, avoids hallucinations, and supports real-time, high-resolution photorealistic stylization with interactive user-controllable color and tone adjustments.

</details>


### [203] [Hierarchically Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Traffic Sign Recognition in Complex Driving Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01822)
*Mingxiao Wang,Xiaozhen Qu,Bolin Gao,Tong Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CBDES MoE TSR，一种基于层次化解耦的异构混合专家框架，用于交通标志识别。通过轻量级门控网络实现图像级动态路由，从专家池中动态选择最合适的YOLO模型，在复合交通标志数据集上mAP50-95达76.8%（提升2.3%），计算开销降低约39.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测器依赖全局共享参数的静态推理，难以同时处理清晰近距样本与远距离小目标、恶劣天气等挑战性场景，缺乏对不同交通场景的适应性。

Method: 提出层次化解耦的异构混合专家框架CBDES MoE TSR，包含异构YOLO专家池和轻量级门控网络。门控模块根据输入图像的语义特征，图像级动态路由选择最合适的专家模型，实现从固定参数拟合到按需动态表征的转变。

Result: 在复合交通标志数据集上，mAP50-95达到76.8%，相比基线方法（74.5%）提升2.3%，同时计算开销降低约39.4%。

Conclusion: 该方法在检测精度和效率之间取得了显著平衡，验证了层次化解耦异构MoE框架在交通标志识别中的有效性。

Abstract: Traffic sign detection is a fundamental component of environmental perception in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. However, most existing detectors rely on static inference with globally shared parameters, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse and unstructured traffic scenarios. As a result, a single static model often struggles to simultaneously handle both clear near-range samples and challenging conditions such as distant small targets or adverse weather environments. To address this limitation, we propose CBDES MoE TSR, a hierarchically decoupled heterogeneous mixture-of-experts(MoE) framework for traffic sign recognition. The proposed framework departs from the conventional globally shared parameter paradigm by introducing a heterogeneous You Only Look Once (YOLO) expert pool together with a lightweight gating network, enabling an image-level dynamic routing mechanism. Based on the semantic characteristics of the input image, the gating module selectively activates the most suitable expert model from the expert pool, enabling a shift from fixed parameter fitting to on-demand dynamic representation. This design enhances feature extraction capability for specific scenarios while maintaining controlled inference overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a remarkable balance between detection accuracy and efficiency on the composite traffic sign dataset. Specifically, our method attains an mAP50-95 of 76.8%, yielding a 2.3% improvement over the baseline method (74.5%) while simultaneously reducing computational overhead by approximately 39.4%. These findings robustly validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [204] [ROGLE: Robust Global-Local Alignment with Automated Region Supervision for Text-Based Person Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01825)
*Zequn Xie,Xibei Jia,Sihang Cai,Shulei Wang,Tao Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROGLE框架，通过自动化的区域-句子匹配策略和多粒度学习，解决了CLIP-based文本行人检索模型中细粒度对齐不足的问题，并构建了首个支持全局与局部评估的大规模P-VLG基准数据集，在长文本查询任务上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TBPS模型（尤其是CLIP-based方法）因全局表征偏差和语义稀疏性，难以实现细粒度图文对齐，且缺乏区域级标注数据。

Method: 提出ROGLE统一框架：1) 自动化的区域-句子匹配(RSM)策略挖掘伪区域-句子对提供细粒度监督；2) 多粒度学习策略融合全局对比学习和区域级局部对齐；3) 构建P-VLG基准数据集（含10万+标注区域和长文本描述）。

Result: ROGLE在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，尤其在长文本查询任务上表现突出。

Conclusion: ROGLE通过自动化细粒度监督和多粒度学习有效提升了TBPS的细粒度对齐能力，P-VLG为未来研究提供了更全面的评估基准。

Abstract: Text-Based Person Search (TBPS) aims to retrieve pedestrian images using natural language queries. However, existing TBPS models, especially those based on CLIP, struggle with fine-grained understanding due to global representational bias and semantic sparsity inherited from training on short captions. This results in weak fine-grained alignment, exacerbated by the scarcity of region-level annotations. To address this, we propose ROGLE (Robust Global-Local Embedding), a unified framework that overcomes reliance on costly manual annotations through an automated Region-to-Sentence Matching (RSM) strategy. RSM automatically mines pseudo region-sentence pairs for scalable fine-grained supervision. Furthermore, ROGLE employs a multi-granular learning strategy that fuses global contrastive learning with region-level local alignment. We also introduce the P-VLG Benchmark, a large-scale dataset constructed by curating and enriching images from established public benchmarks. It features over 100,000 annotated regions and rich long-form captions, making it the first TBPS benchmark to support both global and local assessment protocols. Extensive experiments show that ROGLE significantly outperforms existing approaches, particularly on challenging long-form queries. Code and the P-VLG benchmark will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [205] [Physics-Guided Attention in a Lightweight TCN for Efficient WiFi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01834)
*Chinthaka Ranasingha,Tharindu Fernando,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes,Harshala Gammulle*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于TCN的轻量级WiFi CSI人体动作识别框架，通过引入多普勒能量引导的时间注意力机制和方差驱动的通道注意力机制，在保持高识别精度的同时大幅降低模型参数量和计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的WiFi CSI人体动作识别方法依赖深层、计算密集的架构来隐式捕获运动动态，导致模型复杂度高、效率低。本文旨在通过引入适合CSI信号物理特性的归纳偏置，实现更高效、更有效的学习。

Method: 提出紧凑的TCN框架，显式融入运动感知归纳偏置：(1) 多普勒能量引导的时间注意力机制，强调运动显著的时间段；(2) 方差驱动的通道注意力模块，基于时间运动统计自适应地加权信息子载波。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法在参数量和计算成本显著降低的情况下，性能优于更深的基线模型。

Conclusion: 通过将领域特定的先验知识（归纳偏置）融入轻量级架构，可以在不增加网络深度的情况下有效捕获运动动态，实现精度与效率的更好平衡。

Abstract: Human Action Recognition (HAR) using WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has gained increasing attention due to its non-contact, low-cost, and privacy-preserving nature. However, existing learning-based approaches largely rely on deep, computationally intensive architectures to implicitly capture motion dynamics from CSI measurements, thereby increasing model complexity and reducing efficiency. Instead, we argue that incorporating appropriate inductive biases tailored to the physical characteristics of CSI signals enables more efficient and effective learning. In this work, we propose a compact temporal convolutional network (TCN)-based framework that explicitly incorporates motion-aware inductive biases into feature learning. Specifically, we introduce a Doppler-energy-guided temporal attention mechanism in feature space to emphasize motion-salient time segments, and a variance-driven channel attention module to weight informative subcarriers based on temporal motion statistics adaptively. By integrating these domain-specific priors, the proposed model effectively captures motion dynamics without increasing architectural depth. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to deeper baselines, while significantly reducing parameter count and computational cost.

</details>


### [206] [Suppressing Forgery-Specific Shortcuts for Generalizable Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01843)
*Yihui Wang,Yonghui Yang,Jilong Liu,Fengbin Zhu,Le Wu,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3)框架，通过子空间建模显式表征和抑制伪造方法特定的捷径，在训练和推理阶段分别采用软抑制和神经元衰减策略，显著提升深度伪造检测的跨方法泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型过度依赖伪造方法特定的捷径特征，导致跨方法泛化能力差，缺乏显式识别和抑制这类捷径的机制。

Method: 首先通过轻量线性探针对伪造方法进行分类，利用SVD提取主导捷径子空间；训练阶段在该子空间中对特征表示进行软抑制；推理阶段引入无训练的方式衰减与捷径方向对齐的神经元。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上显著提升了跨方法泛化性能，同时保持了强域内检测能力。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模和抑制方法特定捷径子空间，可有效提升深度伪造检测的泛化性，且推理阶段的无训练增强策略具备即插即用和可解释性优势。

Abstract: Deepfake detection suffers from poor generalization across forgery methods, as existing models tend to rely on spurious method-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to unseen manipulations. While recent approaches attempt to improve generalization, they lack an explicit mechanism to identify and suppress such shortcuts in learned representations. In this work, we propose Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3) framework that explicitly characterizes and suppresses method-specific shortcuts via subspace modeling. Our key insight is that variations distinguishing different forgery methods capture method-specific artifacts and thus serve as an effective proxy for method-specific shortcuts. To this end, we train a lightweight linear probe for forgery method classification and perform Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to extract the dominant shortcut subspace. Building on this formulation, we develop two complementary strategies to reduce shortcut reliance. During training, we softly suppress the shortcut subspace in feature representations, encouraging the model to rely on more generalizable cues for real/fake discrimination. At inference time, we introduce a training-free counterpart that attenuates neurons aligned with the identified shortcut directions, enabling plug-and-play generalization enhancement with improved interpretability. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-method generalization while maintaining strong in-domain performance. The code will be released upon acceptance of the submission.

</details>


### [207] [RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01848)
*Kui Wu,Beiyu Guo,Hao Chen,ShuHang Xu,Yuling Li,Yongdan Zeng,Zhoujun Li,Yizhou Wang,Fangwei Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RescueBench是一个面向搜救任务的四阶段具身智能诊断基准，包含渐进难度级别和自动生成管线。实验表明现有方法在最高难度下无法完成任务，自主探索和空间记忆是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准通常孤立评估具身智能体的探索、交互和空间记忆等能力，忽略了这些能力在真实搜救工作流中组合使用时失败会如何累积和传播的问题。

Method: 构建了四阶段搜救管线（多模态探索→目标救援→记忆引导返回→最终交接），设计五个渐进难度级别，并开发了自动化的episode生成与标注管线。在七个基线和人类玩家上进行了系统评估。

Result: 所有基线在最高难度下均无法完成完整任务。阶段级诊断表明自主探索是主要失败模式，空间记忆是第二个独立瓶颈，且当前拓扑视觉语言导航和基于地图的方法均无法解决这些限制。

Conclusion: RescueBench揭示了现有具身智能方法在组合性搜救任务中的根本局限，为诊断能力瓶颈和指导未来研究提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench

</details>


### [208] [Polaris: Scaling Up Instruction-Guided Image Generation Towards Millions of Personalized Style Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01858)
*Zhi-Kai Chen,Jun-Peng Jiang,Jun-Jie Tao,De-Chuan Zhan,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Polaris是一个智能检索框架，能够从超过6,500个检查点和75,000个适配器的模型库中自动检索并组合最相关的模块，无需额外训练即可实现个性化图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户对图像生成模型的个性化需求日益增长，传统微调方法成本高、难以扩展。社区已积累大量微调模块和适配器库，但缺乏系统化利用这些生态资源的方法，因此需要一种能自动选择和整合现有模块的框架。

Method: 构建包含6,500+检查点和75,000+适配器的大规模索引库，根据用户输入和指令检索最相关的组件，自动选择和整合适合的模型模块，无需额外训练。

Result: 实现了可扩展、可控且对齐良好的图像生成，无需任何额外训练即可满足个性化需求。

Conclusion: Polaris验证了通过智能检索而非重新训练的方式，可以系统化利用现有微调模型生态来满足多样化的用户指令，为个性化图像生成提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Users increasingly expect image generation models to quickly adapt to highly diverse and personalized requirements, such as producing images with distinctive styles or characteristics. Traditional approaches rely on fine-tuning, which is costly and difficult to scale.
