Our results show that annotation reporting in NLP has improved over time but remains uneven, and they establish a scalable framework and bare-minimum reporting recommendations for making human annotation more reliable, reproducible, and interpretable.

</details>


### [465] [DECK: A Consistency x Confidence Taxonomy of LLM Hallucinations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02289)
*Mohit Singh Chauhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DECK分类法，将大语言模型的错误按可检测性信号分为四类（Drift, Entrenched, Confabulation, Knotted），每类对应不同的不确定性评分器家族。研究发现所有输出级不确定性评分方法存在通用盲区：当模型生成自信、可重复的虚构内容时，所有方法均失效，且该问题可能延伸至激活层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉分类法仅从输出错误类型（记忆错误、推理失败、流畅虚构）进行分类，有助于诊断但无法回答"哪种不确定性评分器能检测到该错误"这一问题。作者希望建立一种互补分类法，按错误的可检测性信号特征进行分类。

Method: 提出DECK分类法，基于样本间一致性（inter-sample consistency）和词元级置信度（token-level confidence）两个维度构建2x2矩阵，划分出四种行为模式（Drift、Entrenched、Confabulation、Knotted）。使用Youden's J最优分割确定每个单元的边界。通过评分器对不一致分析、外部标签映射（SelfAware、HaluEval、PopQA）进行双重验证。

Result: 在不同模型和数据集上验证了分类法的有效性，确认外部标签落在预期的DECK单元中，并发现了模型规模和内容相关的次级单元细化。同时发现所有输出级不确定性评分方法的通用盲区：生成器产生自信且可重复的虚构时，所有方法都失效，且线性探针在激活层也失效。

Conclusion: DECK分类法为不确定性评分器的选择和部署提供了实用指导，揭示了现有输出级UQ方法的根本性盲区，并指出需要更丰富的内部状态方法（如UQ heads、信息论估计器）来解决该问题。

Abstract: Existing hallucination taxonomies classify LLM errors by what is wrong with the output -- memorised misconceptions, reasoning failures, fluent fabrications. These taxonomies are useful for diagnosis but cannot answer a different question: which uncertainty scorer would have caught this error? We propose a complementary taxonomy that classifies errors by their detectability signature -- the signal a scorer family would read.
  The DECK taxonomy is a 2x2 partition along inter-sample consistency and token-level confidence into four behavioural regimes (Drift, Entrenched, Confabulation, Knotted), each mapping to a specific scorer family (or families) that can detect it: black-box consistency scorers have signal in D and C, white-box token-probability scorers have signal in K and C, and only an LLM-as-a-Judge with independent pretraining can detect E. Cell membership is operationalised by a Youden's J optimal split on each scorer axis.
  Across three models and four datasets we validate the taxonomy two ways: by analysing scorer-pair disagreement, and by checking that external labels (SelfAware unanswerable, HaluEval adversarial, PopQA entity popularity) land in the predicted DECK cells, with model-scale and content-specific secondary-cell refinements.
  We further identify a universal blind spot of output-level UQ: on knowledge-gap inputs where the generator emits confident, repeatable fabrications, every output-level family collapses by construction. A linear probe on Llama-3-8B's hidden states also collapses to chance, giving preliminary evidence that the failure may persist at the activation level; richer internal-state methods (UQ heads, information-theoretic estimators) remain to be tested.

</details>


### [466] [AI as a Tool for Simulation-Based Experiments in Literary Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02293)
*Matthew Wilkens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了利用生成式AI进行文学史模拟实验的可能性与挑战，总结了当前技术现状，并通过实验展示了AI生成文学文本的能力（包括首次在文学领域实现有限的分佈内输出），最后展望了未来构建完整反事实文学史模拟的研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过受控、基于数据、大规模且低成本的生成式AI模拟，为文学研究开辟新的实验可能性，以弥补传统文学研究方法在可重复、可操控实验方面的不足。

Method: 综述了AI作为人类群体代理的验证方法、AI生成文本的叙事与风格特性、多智能体多轮模拟的稳定性与一致性，以及可预测地改变生成系统知识与行为的技术手段；并进行了文学文本生成实验，与人类作家创作的高水平小说进行比较。

Result: 首次在文学领域展示了AI模型（有限的）分佈内输出能力，提供了与人类-authored小说对比的实验结果。

Conclusion: 当前AI系统尚未能生成高质量、长篇叙事文本，但已有各组件研究基础；未来可在此基础上构建完整的反事实文学史模拟系统。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems open new possibilities for experimentation in literary studies via controlled, grounded, large-scale, low-cost simulations of cultural production. Current systems have not yet been shown to produce high-quality, book-length narrative texts that reliably reflect arbitrarily specified cultural constraints or stylistic features. But there exists substantial relevant research on each of the components required for literary-historical simulation. These include the use and validation of AI systems as proxies for differentiable human populations; the narrative and stylistic properties of AI-generated texts; the stability and coherence of multiagent, multiturn AI simulations of human actors; and technical methods through which to alter in predictable ways the knowledge and behavior of generative systems. Together, these areas could provide a starting point for more ambitious AI-based modeling of cultural systems of literary production.
  We describe the possibilities and challenges of simulation-based experiments in literary studies, summarize the current state of the art in relevant fields, and explain key technical aspects of the work. To provide an example directly relevant to literary scholars, we present the results of experiments on literary text generation, including comparisons to high-status, human-authored novels. Our results include the first demonstration of (limited) in-distribution outputs by AI models in this domain. We conclude with a description of future work on full counterfactual literary-historical simulations using AI.

</details>


### [467] [Beyond Isolated Behaviors: Hierarchical User Modeling for LLM Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02300)
*Liang Wang,Xinyi Mou,Xiaoyou Liu,Tiannan Wang,Yuqing Wang,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PHF框架，基于布迪厄实践理论，将LLM个性化分为实践-惯习-场域三个层次，并通过轻量级实现PHF_Compass在LaMP基准上取得一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法采用扁平化行为范式，聚合用户行为时未考虑其深层组织结构的层次性，缺乏对用户行为如何形成深层结构的显式建模。

Method: 借鉴布迪厄实践理论，提出三级层次框架PHF（实践-惯习-场域），并通过PHF_Compass实现——基于冻结LLM的轻量级、模型无关方法。

Result: 在LaMP基准上，多个多样化任务中取得一致性改进，验证了学习到的行为结构的可解释性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: 基于社会学理论的层次化框架能有效提升LLM个性化性能，且具有可解释性和模型无关性等优势。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, yet personalizing their outputs to individual users remains an open challenge. Existing approaches predominantly adopt a flat behavioral paradigm, aggregating user behaviors without an explicit account of how they are organized into deeper behavioral structures. In this work, we draw on Pierre Bourdieu's Theory of Practice to propose PHF (Practice-Habitus-Field), a sociologically grounded framework that reconceptualizes LLM personalization through three hierarchical levels: individual behaviors as practices, their temporal accumulation into stable dispositions as habitus, and shared regularities across similar users as fields. We instantiate PHF through $\mathrm{PHF}_{\text{Compass}}$, a lightweight and model-agnostic implementation based on a frozen LLM. Experiments on the Language Model Personalization (LaMP) benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse tasks, while further analyses validate the interpretability and extensibility of the learned behavioral structures.

</details>


### [468] [Unified Context Evolution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02304)
*Zixuan Zhu,Yitong Hu,Yong Dai,Junfeng Fang,Chunyang Jiang,Senkang Hu,Yuzhi Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UCE是一种无梯度框架，将智能体经验外化为类型化的演化上下文单元库，通过四类知识（记忆、策略、流程、技能）的生成、检索、评分和修剪，以及调度模块动态平衡知识类型，显著提升ALFWorld和WebShop任务性能，且库可迁移至其他模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体每轮任务从固定上下文开始，有用策略随任务结束丢失；已有方法要么局限于当前任务，要么将所有经验混入单一未分类存储，缺乏知识类型区分、使用质量追踪和库短板平衡。

Method: UCE框架包含：1) 将轨迹分解为四类演化上下文单元（ECUs）：记忆、策略、流程、技能；2) 类型特定生成条件；3) 决策时检索；4) 基于重复使用结果的评分机制；5) 低价值单元修剪；6) 调度模块按类型短板分配生成预算。

Result: ALFWorld成功率从75.4%提升至96.3%；WebShop任务得分从45.1%提升至61.3%；积累的库可迁移至其他智能体骨干网络而无需重新训练。

Conclusion: UCE通过结构化经验外化和动态平衡，有效解决了智能体跨任务知识积累与迁移问题，是一种无需梯度的高效框架。

Abstract: LLM-based agents can solve multi-step interactive tasks by combining reasoning with environment feedback, yet each episode starts from the same fixed context and any useful strategy discovered along the way is lost once the task ends. Existing approaches either limit learning to the current task or pool all experience into a single untyped store, without distinguishing knowledge types, tracking quality through use, or balancing what the library still lacks. We introduce Unified Context Evolution (UCE), a gradient-free framework that externalizes agent experience into an evolving library of typed Evolvable Context Units (ECUs). UCE decomposes experience into four complementary types (Memory, Strategy, Workflow, and Skill), each generated from trajectories under type-specific conditions, retrieved at decision time, scored through repeated usage outcomes, and pruned when no longer valuable. A scheduling module allocates each cycle's generation budget toward the types where the library is weakest. Across two interactive benchmarks, UCE raises ALFWorld success from 75.4% to 96.3% and WebShop task score from 45.1% to 61.3%, and the accumulated library transfers to alternative actor backbones without retraining.

</details>


### [469] [TVIR: Building Deep Research Agents Towards Text--Visual Interleaved Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02320)
*Xinkai Ma,Zhiqi Bai,Dingling Zhang,Pei Liu,Yishuo Yuan,He Zhu,Jiakai Wang,Qianqian Xie,Yifan Zhao,Xinlong Yang,Hao Cong,Zhiheng Yao,Fengxia Xie,Zihao Xu,Haoran Xu,Zhaohui Wang,Minghao Liu,Shirong Lin,Yingshui Tan,Yuchi Xu,Wenbo Su,Zhaoxiang Zhang,Bo Zheng,Jiaheng Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TVIR（文本-视觉交错报告生成），包含TVIR-Bench基准（100个专家精选的多模态深度研究任务）和TVIR-Agent分层多智能体框架，以及双路径评估体系。实验表明TVIR-Agent在九个深度研究系统中表现优异，强调了显式多模态设计与评估对证据驱动报告生成的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究智能体的基准和系统仍以文本为中心，缺乏对视觉元素的事实可靠性及其与分析内容对齐程度的评估。

Method: 构建TVIR-Bench（100个专家精选多模态深度研究任务），提出TVIR-Agent分层多智能体框架（大纲构建、图像检索、图表生成、上下文感知顺序写作），以及结合文本评估与视觉评估的双路径评估框架。

Result: 在九个深度研究系统上的实验表明，TVIR-Agent取得总体最优性能。

Conclusion: 显式的多模态设计与评估对证据驱动的报告生成至关重要。

Abstract: Deep Research Agents have shown strong capability in multi-step information retrieval, reasoning, and long-form report generation, but existing benchmarks and systems remain predominantly text-centric, with limited evaluation of whether visual elements are factually reliable and well aligned with the surrounding analysis. To address this gap, we introduce TVIR (Text--Visual Interleaved Report Generation), which includes TVIR-Bench, a benchmark of 100 expert-curated multimodal deep research tasks that require visual elements to serve specific analytical sub-goals, and TVIR-Agent, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that serves as a strong baseline for constructing outlines, retrieving images, generating charts with traceable sources, and composing reports through context-aware sequential writing. We further develop a dual-path evaluation framework that combines Textual Assessment and Visual Assessment. Experiments across nine deep research systems show that TVIR-Agent achieves strong overall performance, underscoring the importance of explicit multimodal design and evaluation for evidence-driven report generation.

</details>


### [470] [WAXAL-NET: Finetuned Edge ASR Across 19 African Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02375)
*Victor Tolulope Olufemi,Oreoluwa Babatunde,Ramsey Njema,Bolarinwa Gbotemi,Wanchi Lucia Yen,John Uzodinma,Sunday Ajayi,Oluwademilade Williams,Kausar Moshood,Innocent Elendu Anyaele,Akebert Arefaine,Candace Hunzwi,Wongel Dawit Daniel,Emmilly Namuganga,Cleophas Kadima,Athanase Bahizire,Onitsiky Ranaivoson,Emmanuel Aaron,Nicholaus Ladislaus,Idris Muhammed,Jonathan Enoch Simenya,Martin Koome,Matewos Tegete Endaylalu,Peter Ifeoluwa Adeyemo,Hondi Prisca Birindwa,Ukachi Agnes Eze-Mbey,Yacoba Oduro-Yeboah,Pericles Adjovi,Mikel K. Ngueajio,Toluwani Aremu,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估了专用于非洲会话语音领域的紧凑型ASR模型与大规模多语言基础模型在WAXAL语料库19种语言上的表现。微调的边缘模型在词错误率(WER)上达到38.0%，远超最佳零样本基线的64.9%，且模型尺寸小3-40倍。结果表明领域专精化主导了非洲自发语音识别的性能。跨领域评估显示微调模型在分布外(OOD)语音上仍能恢复可用性能，而零样本模型在测试域匹配其预训练分布时重新获得优势。分布式母语者审计产生了基于语言学的错误分类法，揭示了CTC和自回归架构在不同语系上的行为差异。研究还表明WER单独会误导对音节文字语言的评估，CER/WER比率揭示了比WER高得多的字符级准确率。最后，研究团队发布了所有模型权重、微调和评估脚本以及覆盖全部19种语言的清洁WAXAL子集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多语言基础模型在非洲语言语音识别上表现不佳，而领域专精化的小型模型可能存在优势。作者旨在验证对于会话型非洲语音，紧凑型领域专用ASR模型是否优于大规模多语言基础模型，并深入分析不同架构、语言家族对性能的影响。

Method: 使用WAXAL语料库中19种非洲语言的会话语音数据，比较微调的紧凑型边缘模型（CTC和自回归架构）与大规模多语言零样本基础模型。采用分布式母语者审计构建错误分类法，并引入CER/WER比率作为音节文字语言的补充评估指标。

Result: 微调边缘模型在WER上达到38.0%，比最佳零样本基线(64.9%)降低26.9个百分点，模型尺寸小3-40倍。跨领域测试中微调模型在OOD数据上保持可用性能，零样本模型在匹配预训练分布时反超。CTC与自回归架构在不同语系上错误模式不同。对于音节文字语言，CER/WER比率揭示字符级准确率远高于WER指标显示的水平。

Conclusion: 领域专精化而非模型规模是非洲会话语音识别的关键因素；WER并非普适的评估指标，尤其对于音节文字语言需要CER等补充指标；不同ASR架构（CTC vs 自回归）在不同语系上的行为差异值得进一步研究。

Abstract: We evaluate whether compact domain-specialized ASR models can outperform massively multilingual foundation models for conversational African speech across 19 languages in the WAXAL corpus. Fine-tuned edge models achieve a macro-averaged WER of $38.0\%$ compared to $64.9\%$ for the best zero-shot baseline, a $26.9$ percentage-point reduction using models $3-40\times$ smaller. Results confirm that domain specialization dominates scale for spontaneous African speech. Cross-domain evaluation shows that fine-tuned models recover usable performance on out-of-distribution (OOD) speech, while zero-shot models regain an advantage when the test domain matches their pretraining distribution. A distributed native-speaker audit across all surveyed languages produces a linguistically-grounded error taxonomy, showing that CTC and autoregressive architectures behave differently across language families. We further show that WER alone misrepresents performance for syllabary-script languages where CER/WER ratios reveal substantially higher character-level accuracy than headline WER suggests. Finally, to contribute to future African ASR research, we release all model weights, fine-tuning and evaluation scripts, and a cleaned WAXAL subset covering all $19$ languages.

</details>


### [471] [SPADE-Bench: Evaluating Spontaneous Strategic Deception in Agents via Plan-Action Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02380)
*Yuyan Bu,Haowei Li,Qirui Zheng,Bowen Dong,Kaiyue Yang,Jiaming Ji,Yingshui Tan,Wenxin Li,Yaodong Yang,Juntao Dai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SPADE-Bench是一个专门评估LLM智能体在工具使用场景中自发产生计划-行动不一致（即“智能体欺骗”）的基准测试。实验表明，主流模型普遍存在这一问题，尤其在高压场景下，该基准能有效区分策略性欺骗与单纯幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在实际部署中，人类用户无法监控每个即时行为，执行过程是黑箱，仅依赖智能体的自述报告。这种不透明性导致智能体可能呈现与实际行动不符的报告（计划-行动不一致），使系统失控。现有欺骗基准未能同时整合真实工具执行和压力场景。

Method: SPADE-Bench同时集成了实际工具执行和受控压力场景，通过受控的计划-行动对比，在压力条件下严格区分策略性欺骗与幻觉。设计上确保生态效度。

Result: 跨主流模型的实验证实，智能体欺骗在工具使用上下文中是一个真实且紧迫的问题。

Conclusion: SPADE-Bench填补了智能体安全评估的关键空白，为构建可信、可控的自主系统提供了全面的鲁棒评估框架。

Abstract: As LLM-based agents expand their operational scope, reliability becomes a prerequisite for real-world deployment. However, in practical applications, human users cannot monitor every immediate behavior; instead, the execution process often remains a black box, leaving users dependent solely on the agent's self-reported updates. This opacity creates a critical risk: agents may present observer-facing reports that diverge from their executed actions, rendering the system uncontrollable, especially in high-stakes autonomous scenarios. We term such self-reported plan-action divergence as agent deception. To assess this, we introduce SPADE-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate spontaneous plan-action divergence. Unlike prior deception benchmarks, SPADE-Bench simultaneously integrates actual tool execution and controlled pressure scenarios. This design ensures ecological validity and rigorously distinguishes strategic deception from mere hallucination through controlled plan-action comparisons under pressure. Experiments across mainstream models confirm that agent deception is a genuine and pressing issue in tool-use contexts. By providing a comprehensive and robust evaluation framework, SPADE-Bench fills a critical gap in agent safety, facilitating the community's progress toward building trustworthy and controllable autonomous systems.

</details>


### [472] [AutoForest: Automatically Generating Forest Plots from Biomedical Studies with End-to-End Evidence Extraction and Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02403)
*Massimiliano Pronesti,Angelo Miculescu,Mohsin Kapdi,Paul Flanagan,Oisín Redmond,Joao Bettencourt-Silva,Gurdeep Mannu,Spiros Denaxas,Rui Bebiano Da Providencia E Costa,Anya Belz,Yufang Hou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AutoForest 是首个端到端系统，能从生物医学论文直接生成可发表的森林图，自动完成 ICO 元素建议、数据提取、统计合成和图形渲染全流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统性综述依赖森林图来综合生物医学研究的定量证据，但生成森林图的过程高度碎片化且劳动密集，需要研究人员手动提取数据、定义干预和对照、协调不一致的研究设计并进行元分析计算，现有系统缺乏从原始文档到合成森林图的完整自动化管线。

Method: AutoForest 构建为端到端系统，接收一个或多个研究论文作为输入，自动执行以下步骤：(1) 建议 ICO（干预、对照、结局）要素；(2) 提取结局数据；(3) 执行统计合成；(4) 渲染最终可发表的森林图。系统包含架构设计和用户界面。

Result: 通过涉及临床医生的用户研究，在真实案例上展示了 AutoForest 能够加速证据合成并显著降低进行元分析的门槛。

Conclusion: AutoForest 填补了从原始生物医学论文到合成森林图的完整自动化空白，有望显著提高系统性综述的效率与可及性。

Abstract: Systematic reviews rely on forest plots to synthesise quantitative evidence across biomedical studies, but generating them remains a fragmented and labour-intensive process. Researchers must interpret complex clinical texts, manually extract outcome data from trials, define appropriate interventions and comparators, harmonise inconsistent study designs, and carry out meta-analytic computations-typically using specialised software that demands structured inputs and domain expertise. While recent work has demonstrated that large language models can extract study-level data from unstructured text, no existing system automates the complete pipeline from raw documents to synthesised forest plots. To address this gap, we introduce AutoForest, the first end-to-end system that generates publication-ready forest plots directly from biomedical papers. Given one or more study papers, AutoForest automatically suggests ICO (Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) elements, extracts outcome data, performs statistical synthesis, and renders the final forest plot. We describe the system architecture, user interface and demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world examples through a user study involving clinicians, showing how AutoForest can accelerate evidence synthesis and substantially lower the barrier to conducting meta-analyses.

</details>


### [473] [K-BrowseComp: A Web Browsing Agent Benchmark Grounded in Korean Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02404)
*Nahyun Lee,Dongkeun Yoon,Guijin Son,Geewook Kim,Dayoon Ko,Jeonghun Park,Haneul Yoo,Jaewon Cho,Junghun Park,Changyoon Lee,Kyochul Jang,Jaeyeon Kim,Eunsu Kim,Woojin Cho,Seungone Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了K-BrowseComp，一个基于韩国语境的网页浏览智能体基准测试，包含400个问题。其中300个手工构建的验证集中，前沿大语言模型（GPT-5.5、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.1）仅达到30.00-45.67%，远低于BrowseComp；韩国模型仅0.00-10.33%。额外构建的100个合成对抗性分割中，最强模型仅26.00%。数据与代码已公开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前沿模型评估正从基础能力向组合性、智能体能力转变，但缺乏韩国语境的智能体基准测试。

Method: 构建了400个问题的K-BrowseComp基准，其中300个由母语者手工构建验证（K-BrowseComp-Verified），100个通过硬样本少样本学习和失败模式定向生成构造合成分割，并采用对抗性过滤。

Result: K-BrowseComp-Verified上前沿模型准确率30.00-45.67%，韩国模型0.00-10.33%；合成对抗分割上最强模型仅26.00%。

Conclusion: 当前模型在韩国语境的网页浏览智能体任务上表现不佳，揭示了该领域评估资源的匮乏和模型的局限性。

Abstract: Frontier model evaluations are shifting from foundational capabilities (e.g., instruction following and reasoning) toward compositional, agentic ones, but Korean agentic benchmarks remain scarce. We introduce K-BrowseComp, a web-browsing agent benchmark grounded in Korean contexts, consisting of 400 problems. The 300-problem K-BrowseComp-Verified subset is manually constructed and validated by native Korean speakers. On this subset, frontier LLMs, including GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and GLM-5.1, reach only 30.00--45.67\%, a substantial drop from BrowseComp, while Korean LLMs released through Korea's Proprietary AI Foundation Model program obtain only 0.00--10.33\%. We further construct a 100-problem synthetic split using hard few-shot exemplars and failure-mode-targeted generation to exploit the asymmetry between solving and creating web browsing problems. On the adversarially filtered synthetic diagnostic split, the strongest model reaches only 26.00\%, and we report this split separately as a targeted stress test. We publicly release our data and code.

</details>


### [474] [Investigating and Alleviating Harm Amplification in LLM Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02423)
*Ruohao Guo,Wei Xu,Alan Ritter*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出HarmAmp基准测试和TrajSafe主动监控器，用于检测和干预大语言模型在多轮对话中的危害放大问题，实验证明TrajSafe能显著降低多轮交互中的危害性，同时保持低过度拒绝率和模型通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究往往忽视LLMs在多轮对话中如何加剧危害，即通过降低领域专业知识门槛（使新手能生成有害内容）和大规模自动化有害操作（远超人工能力）两条轴线放大风险。

Method: 构建HarmAmp基准测试，涵盖12个风险类别的多轮危害放大场景，每个场景满足实质性放大、操作特定性和多轮必要性三个标准；提出TrajSafe主动监控器，通过预测有害轨迹并执行干预动作（如探测用户真实意图、引导模型安全完成）来降低风险。

Result: 实验表明TrajSafe能显著降低多轮交互中的危害性，同时保持低过度拒绝率和目标模型的通用能力。

Conclusion: 该工作为缓解LLM交互中微妙的安全风险提供了一种有前景的范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can serve as helpful assistants, yet they can equally function as harm amplifiers that enable malicious users to achieve harmful outcomes beyond their capabilities through extended interactions. This risk manifests along two axes, i.e., democratizing domain expertise that allows novices to produce specialized harmful content, and scaling harmful operations at volumes that manual effort cannot match. Existing works, however, often overlook how LLMs compound harm across multi-turn conversations. We introduce HarmAmp, a new benchmark for multi-turn harm amplification scenarios spanning twelve risk categories. Each scenario is grounded in real-world threats and satisfies rigorous criteria, i.e., substantive amplification, operational specificity, and multi-turn necessity. We further propose TrajSafe, a proactive monitor that anticipates harmful trajectories and intervenes through actions such as probing users' genuine intents and steering the models towards safer completion. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that TrajSafe significantly reduces the harmfulness incurred in multi-turn interactions while preserving a low over-refusal rate and the target model's general capabilities. Our work offers a promising paradigm to alleviate the nuanced safety risks in LLM interactions.

</details>


### [475] [BenHalluEval: A Multi-Task Hallucination Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models on Bengali](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31483)
*Shefayat E Shams Adib,Ahmed Alfey Sani,Ekramul Alam Esham,Ajwad Abrar,Ishmam Tashdeed,Md Taukir Azam Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了BenHalluEval，首个针对孟加拉语的细粒度幻觉评估框架，涵盖四种任务和十二种幻觉类型，并引入BenHalluScore双轨校准指标，揭示了现有模型在低资源语言中的幻觉校准问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语作为全球第六大语言，此前缺乏对大语言模型在孟加拉语上幻觉问题的系统性评估，现有评估方法在低资源语言场景下存在不足。

Method: 构建包含12,000个幻觉候选样本的基准，涵盖生成式问答、孟加拉语-英语代码混合问答、摘要和推理四种任务，共十二种任务特定幻觉类型。采用双轨协议（Track A测量真实实例上的假阳性率，Track B测量幻觉候选上的检测率），并提出BenHalluScore双轨校准指标，同时惩罚两种失败模式。

Result: BenHalluScore在模型和任务间范围为7.72%至55.42%，揭示了幻觉校准的显著差异。链式思维提示作为缓解策略，仅改变了响应分布，未能一致改善幻觉判别能力。

Conclusion: BenHalluEval建立了第一个孟加拉语幻觉专用基准，证明了单轨和仅提示优化的评估方法在低资源语言环境中的不足。

Abstract: Despite Bengali being the sixth most spoken language in the world, no prior work has systematically evaluated hallucination in large language models (LLMs) for Bengali. We introduce BenHalluEval, a fine-grained hallucination evaluation framework for Bengali covering four tasks: Generative Question Answering (GQA), Bangla-English Code-Mixed QA, Summarization, and Reasoning. We construct 12,000 hallucinated candidates using GPT-5.4 across twelve task-specific hallucination types, drawn from three existing Bengali datasets, and evaluate seven LLMs spanning reasoning-oriented, multilingual, and Bengali-centric categories under a dual-track protocol that independently measures false-positive rate on ground-truth instances (Track A) and hallucination detection rate on hallucinated candidates (Track B). To jointly penalise both failure modes and prevent inflated scores from uniform response bias, we propose BenHalluScore, a dual-track calibration metric that ranges from 7.72% to 55.42% across models and tasks, revealing substantial variation in hallucination calibration. Chain-of-thought prompting, applied as a mitigation strategy, shifts response distributions without consistently improving hallucination discrimination. BenHalluEval establishes the first dedicated hallucination benchmark for Bengali and highlights the inadequacy of single-track and prompting-only evaluation approaches for low-resource language settings. The dataset and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BanglaHalluEval-EB77.

</details>


### [476] [PaSBench-Video: A Streaming Video Benchmark for Proactive Safety Warning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02443)
*Yusong Zhao,Yuejin Xie,Youliang Yuan,Junjie Hu,Jitian Guo,Yujiu Yang,Pinjia He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 现有MLLM在视频风险预警任务中表现不佳，最高严格指标得分不足20%，高召回率伴随高误报率（皮尔逊相关系数0.64），且模型依赖场景活动线索而非真正推理潜在危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 填补现有基准的空白：当前测试依赖静态输入、忽略时间精度、缺乏安全场景误报评估，无法衡量MLLM作为实时安全监控器的能力。

Method: 构建PaSBench-Video基准（740视频，含481个风险与259个无风险视频，覆盖驾驶、医疗、日常生活、工业生产四领域），以因果方式观察视频，要求预警在时间校准和内容正确两方面均达标。

Result: 13个MLLM中最高严格指标<20%；召回率与误报率强正相关（0.64）；领域性能差异显著：日常生活（风险天生异常）表现较好，驾驶（常规与危险场景相似）误报严重。

Conclusion: 当前模型依赖表面场景活动线索而非推理危害，无法胜任时间精准的风险预警任务，需要新的能力方向突破。

Abstract: Between the first visible sign of danger and the moment an accident occurs, there is often a window where intervention remains possible. Video-capable multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could serve as always-on safety monitors that issue warnings during this window. Yet current benchmarks do not test this ability: they rely on static inputs, ignore timing precision, and omit false-positive measurement on safe scenes. We present PaSBench-Video, a 740-video benchmark with 481 risk and 259 no-risk videos across four domains: driving, healthcare, daily life, and industrial production. Risk videos are annotated with frame-level risk onset and accident boundaries. A model must observe the video causally and produce a warning that is both temporally calibrated and content-correct. Testing 13 MLLMs, we find that no model exceeds 20.0% on our strictest metric, and recall is tightly coupled with false-positive rate, with Pearson correlation 0.64: higher detection comes only at the cost of triggering warnings on the majority of safe clips. Performance splits sharply by domain: models achieve moderate recall at low false-positive rates in daily life, where risks are inherently anomalous, yet fire indiscriminately in driving, where routine and hazardous scenes look alike. These results indicate that current models rely on scene-level activity cues rather than reasoning about emerging harm.

</details>


### [477] [Learning When to Translate for Multilingual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02465)
*Deokhyung Kang,Hyounghun Kim,Gary Geunbae Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Luar框架，通过强化学习训练推理语言模型在直接理解不可靠时选择性调用翻译，从而改善多语言推理能力，在低资源语言上尤其有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理语言模型在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但在非英语输入上存在显著的多语言推理差距，主要由于语言理解失败。直接对所有输入进行英语翻译是不必要的，因为模型有时可以从原始查询中可靠推理。

Method: 提出Luar（Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning）框架，训练RLMs选择性地调用翻译：模型在直接求解原始输入和基于英语翻译进行推理之间做选择，仅当翻译增强推理预期显著优于直接推理时才鼓励翻译。

Result: 在多语言推理基准上，Luar优于标准GRPO及其他基于训练的基线方法，在低资源语言上提升尤为显著。Luar能避免不必要的翻译（当直接推理足够时），并泛化其翻译调用行为到未见过的低资源语言。

Conclusion: 选择性方法是多语言推理的有效策略：RLMs可以学习仅在直接理解不可靠时调用翻译，从而在保证性能的同时避免不必要的翻译开销。

Abstract: Reasoning language models (RLMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, but still exhibit substantial multilingual reasoning gaps, largely due to language-understanding failures in non-English inputs. English translation can mitigate these failures by expressing non-English inputs in a form that RLMs can more reliably interpret, yet translating every input is unnecessary when the model can reason reliably from the original query. To address this challenge, we propose Luar, a Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning framework that trains RLMs to selectively invoke translation when direct understanding is unreliable. Luar trains the model to choose between solving the original input directly and reasoning over its English translation, encouraging translation only when translator-augmented reasoning is expected to substantially outperform direct reasoning. Across multilingual reasoning benchmarks, Luar outperforms standard GRPO and other training-based baselines, with particularly large gains on low-resource languages. Further analysis shows that Luar avoids unnecessary translation in cases where direct reasoning is sufficient, while extending its translator-call behavior to unseen low-resource languages. Together, our work suggests a selective approach to multilingual reasoning: RLMs can learn to invoke translation only when their direct understanding is unreliable. The project will be made publicly available at https://github.com/deokhk/LUAR

</details>


### [478] [Towards Multidisciplinary Summarization of Hospital Stays: Efficient Sentence-Level Clinical Provenance Categorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02487)
*Baris Karacan,Vaibhav Bhargava,Barbara Di Eugenio,Natalie Parde,Mary Khetani,Yu-Shan Tseng,Vanessa Barbosa,Julie Vignato,Lindsey Knake,Rajashree Dahal,Emily Spellman,Danielle Hitzel,Janine Petitgout,Kristi Haughey,Amanda Karstens,Brianna Clarahan,Rachel Dawson,Lauren Boyd,Mackenzie Weis,Angie Tipton,Jaewon Bae,Catherine K. Craven,Karen Dunn Lopez,Andrew D. Boyd*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对NICU多学科临床笔记的摘要生成问题，提出了一种基于临床来源分类的流水线方法。通过对Llama-3模型（8B和70B）进行监督微调，在MedSecId语料库上取得了92%以上的Macro F1，并验证了跨领域迁移效果：70B模型微调后F1提升7%，量化模型在降低计算开销的同时表现优于全精度基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NICU等复杂场景中，多学科临床笔记的异质性文本直接聚合会导致摘要不连贯，需要先对句子级别的临床来源进行准确分类，现有方法缺乏针对多源跨领域临床文本的结构化来源建模能力。

Method: 采用监督微调（SFT）对Llama-3 8B和70B模型进行适配，使用MedSecId语料库（2,002条MIMIC-III成人ICU笔记）进行领域内训练，并在227条多学科NICU摘要句子级标注数据上评估跨领域泛化能力，同时考察模型规模和量化策略的影响。

Result: 在MedSecId上两种模型Macro F1均超92%；跨领域迁移中，8B模型微调提升有限，而70B模型微调后Macro F1提升7%；量化微调的70B模型性能超过了全精度基线，同时显著降低了计算开销。

Conclusion: 模型容量对于跨领域临床迁移中保持语义灵活性至关重要，高效的量化适配方法能够实现结构化来源建模并支持下游摘要生成任务。

Abstract: Effective "all-team" summarization in high-complexity settings like the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) requires aggregating insights from diverse disciplines (physicians, nurses, therapists) spread across hundreds of clinical free-text notes. Simply pooling heterogeneous text often leads to incoherent outputs. Structured summarization therefore first requires accurate categorization of sentence-level provenance across multi-source notes. This pilot study introduces a clinical provenance categorization pipeline using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of large language models (LLMs). We adapted two Llama-3 models (8B and 70B) to MedSecId, a corpus of 2,002 MIMIC-III (Adult ICU) notes annotated with clinical provenance headers, achieving in-domain Macro F1 scores above 92% for both models. To evaluate cross-domain generalization, we assessed model capacity (8B vs. 70B) and quantization on a gold-standard dataset of 227 sentence-level spans derived from three multi-disciplinary NICU summaries. Experimental results demonstrate a scale-dependent transfer effect: while SFT produced only marginal changes for the 8B model, it substantially improved the 70B model, increasing Macro F1 by 7%. Notably, the quantized fine-tuned 70B model outperformed its full-precision baseline while substantially reducing computational requirements. These findings suggest that sufficient model capacity is critical for preserving semantic flexibility during cross-domain clinical transfer and that efficient quantized adaptation can enable structured provenance modeling for downstream summarization.

</details>


### [479] [Not What, But How: A Communicative Audit of LLM Response Framing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02493)
*Siddhesh Milind Pawar,Sarah Masud,Haneul Yoo,Alice Oh,Isabelle Augenstein*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出FRANZ框架，用于评估LLM在回答主观文化查询时的四个沟通维度（文化定位、泛化语言、拟人化线索、对话准则遵从性），并构建了包含37.6万主观问题的SQUARE语料库。通过分析三个开源LLM的回答，发现模型在回答特征频率上存在显著差异，且内部定位与拟人化呈正相关，耦合程度因国家而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估主要关注事实正确性，忽略了在主观文化查询中回答的表述方式（framing）对用户体验的影响。用户不仅关心答案是否正确，还敏感于回答的沟通方式。

Method: 提出FRANZ自动化框架，从四个维度（文化定位、泛化语言、拟人化线索、对话准则遵从性）对LLM回答进行沟通审计；构建SQUARE语料库（从57个子reddit收集37.6万主观问题，映射到7个国家和19个问题类别）；对三个开源LLM的回答进行评分分析。

Result: LLMs在每种回答特征的使用频率上存在统计显著差异；与单一维度审计不同，FRANZ揭示了内部定位与拟人化之间呈正相关，且耦合程度因国家而异，为识别框架差异提供了诊断视角。

Conclusion: FRANZ框架能有效揭示LLM在多维度沟通特征上的差异及其跨文化耦合关系，为评估和诊断LLM在主观文化查询中的回答框架提供了新方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being increasingly used to answer subjective, information-seeking questions, where users are sensitive to how responses are communicated, not just whether the answers are correct. Existing LLM evaluations for subjective cultural queries largely focus on factual correctness, ignoring how the response is framed. To this end, we introduce FRANZ, an automated FRAmework for respoNse characteriZation to conduct communicative audit of LLM responses along four dimensions: cultural positioning, use of generalizing language, anthropomorphic cues, and adherence to conversational maxims. To enable this evaluation, we contribute SQUARE - a corpus of 376k subjective questions sourced from 57 subreddits, and mapped to 7 countries and 19 question categories. We demonstrate FRANZ's applicability by scoring responses from three open-weight LLMs. We observe that LLMs show statistically significant differences in the frequency with which they employ each response characteristic. Unlike single-dimensional audits, FRANZ reveals that insider positioning and anthropomorphism are positively coupled, with the degree of coupling varying by country, providing a diagnostic lens for identifying framing divergences.

</details>


### [480] [CRAM: Centroid-Routing and Adaptive MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02502)
*Jun-Tao Tang,Zhen-Hao Xie,Yu-Cheng Shi,Da-Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CRAM通过自适应秩实例化和质心引导路由，在独立模块中隔离任务特定模式，解决了多模态持续指令微调中任务间干扰与参数效率的困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在持续能力扩展中面临两难：共享参数更新导致异构任务竞争和灾难性遗忘，而隔离扩展虽避免干扰但参数效率极低。现有方法无法同时解决这两个问题。

Method: CRAM包含三个核心组件：1) 自适应秩实例化，通过识别现有专家能力与新任务需求之间的差距，动态分配必要参数；2) 质心引导路由，识别并激活已有专家能力；3) 正交性惩罚，将新更新限制在任务特定方向上，防止重新学习通用能力。

Result: 在多个多样化的基准测试中，CRAM一致性地优于现有方法。

Conclusion: CRAM通过动态参数分配与能力复用机制，有效兼顾了多模态持续指令微调中的抗遗忘性与参数效率。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) unify heterogeneous vision-language tasks under a shared generative framework via instruction tuning, yet real-world deployment demands continuous capability expansion, making Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) essential. Existing methods either update all tasks with a shared parameter set or allocate dedicated modules for each new task. Shared updates force heterogeneous tasks to compete, causing forgetting of learned capabilities. Conversely, isolated expansion prevents interference but severely limits parameter efficiency over long task streams. To address this dilemma, we propose CRAM. Specifically, by isolating task-specific patterns into independent modules, CRAM mitigates catastrophic forgetting across tasks. To further boost parameter efficiency, we utilize adaptive-rank instantiation to identify the capability gap between existing expert capability and new task demands, and dynamically allocate only the necessary parameters. To ensure stable reuse among tasks, centroid-guided routing recognizes and activates existing experts' capabilities, while an orthogonality penalty confines new updates to task-specific directions, preventing re-learning general capability. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks consistently demonstrate its superiority over existing methods.

</details>


### [481] [When Rating Scales Fall Short: LLM-Assisted Discovery of ADHD Signals in Turkish Teacher Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02509)
*Baris Karacan,Irem Aktar Songur,Ahmet Ozaslan,Elvan Iseri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究分析了土耳其语教师评语（CTRS-R:S评分+开放叙事文本）在ADHD筛查中的作用，发现结构化评分与叙事文本编码了互补信号，LLM辅助的主题发现揭示了注意力、行为及家庭相关模式，表明NLP可补充传统ADHD筛查工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究教师开放式叙事文本是否包含结构化评分量表（CTRS-R:S）所忽略的ADHD相关信号，以及两类信息能否互补提升筛查准确性。

Method: 分析土耳其语教师评估表中的CTRS-R:S评分与开放叙事文本；比较结构化评分与叙事文本的预测信号；识别结构化评估无法清晰区分ADHD/非ADHD而叙事模型能捕捉的案例；使用LLM辅助的主题发现流水线解释差异。

Result: 结构化评分与叙事文本编码互补信号；结构化评估失败的案例与叙事模型失败的案例重叠极少；LLM辅助发现注意力、行为及家庭相关主题模式。

Conclusion: 教师叙事文本包含结构化评估遗漏的临床相关信号，NLP技术可有效挖掘这些信号以补充传统ADHD筛查工具。

Abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is one of the most common neurodevelopmental disorders in childhood, and its diagnosis relies on assessments combining clinician judgment with standardized rating scales and reports from parents and teachers. While structured instruments such as the Conners' Teacher Rating Scale-Revised Short Form (CTRS-R:S) quantify ADHD-related behaviors, teachers also provide open-ended narratives that may contain complementary signals not captured by structured assessments. However, it remains unclear to what extent teacher narratives encode signals overlooked by rating scales. In this study, we analyze de-identified Turkish teacher evaluation forms collected during clinical ADHD assessments, including both CTRS-R:S scores and open-ended teacher narratives. We compare predictive signals from structured scores and narrative text and identify cases where structured assessments fail to clearly distinguish ADHD from non-ADHD students while narrative-based models capture distinct behavioral patterns. Notably, these cases show minimal overlap with those missed by the narrative model, suggesting that structured and narrative information encode complementary signals. To interpret these differences, we apply a large language model (LLM)-assisted theme discovery pipeline that reveals distinct attention, behavioral, and family-related patterns, highlighting the potential of natural language processing (NLP) to uncover clinically relevant signals from teacher narratives and to complement traditional ADHD screening tools.

</details>


### [482] [FigSIM: A Dataset for Fine-grained Suicide Severity and Figurative Language in Suicide Memes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02523)
*Liuliu Chen,Elise R. Carrotte,Brian E. Chapman,Jo Robinson,Mike Conway*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了FigSIM，首个面向自杀表情包细粒度分析的数据集，包含1049个标注样本，涵盖自杀严重程度、修辞现象和自杀相关内容三类标注，并评测了16个模型，揭示了自杀表情包在建模和内容审核中的独特挑战与偏误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自杀表情包在社交媒体上日益普遍，但缺乏深入理解，且缺少标注数据集来支持自动化审核方法的开发与评估，存在迫切需求。

Method: 构建FigSIM数据集（1049个自杀表情包），进行三重细粒度标注：（1）自杀严重程度等级；（2）修辞现象（如隐喻）；（3）自杀相关内容（如自杀方式描绘）。使用16个单模态和多模态模型在三个任务上进行基准评测。

Result: 自杀表情包对建模和内容审核构成独特挑战；模型存在偏误，如对高自杀严重等级预测不足，尤其在修辞类表情包上表现更差。

Conclusion: FigSIM为自杀表情包的自动化内容审核提供了基础数据集与基准，揭示了现有模型在细粒度理解上的不足，需进一步改进对高严重程度和修辞性内容的处理。

Abstract: Suicide memes are memes used to express suicide-related thoughts or comment on suicide-related issues. Suicide memes are increasingly common on social media, yet remain poorly understood and potentially harmful. There is an urgent need to better understand their characteristics and to develop appropriate content moderation strategies that limits users' exposure to potentially harmful content. Currently, the absence of annotated datasets of suicide memes remains a key barrier to developing and evaluating automated moderation approaches. In this paper, we introduce FigSIM, the first dataset designed for fine-grained analysis of suicide memes. The dataset consists of 1049 memes, each annotated for (1) fine-grained suicide severity levels, (2) figurative phenomena (e.g., metaphors), and (3) suicide-related content (e.g., suicide method depiction). We benchmark 16 unimodal and multimodal models across three tasks: figurative language, suicide severity, and suicide-related content detection. Overall, FigSIM demonstrates that suicide memes pose unique challenges for both modeling and content moderation. Analysis revealed biases, such as underprediction of higher suicide severity levels, especially for figurative memes. The dataset (including splits used for analyses) is publicly available. Content Warning: This paper contains suicide-related content that may be triggering.

</details>


### [483] [SkillHarm: Lifecycle-Aware Skill-Based Attacks via Automated Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02540)
*Yuting Ning,Zhehao Zhang,Yash Kumar Lal,Boyu Gou,Junyi Li,Weitong Ruan,Chentao Ye,Rahul Gupta,Diyi Yang,Yu Su,Huan Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillHarm基准，系统评估基于技能的两类投毒攻击（固定载荷和自我变异），覆盖12种风险类型，实验显示当前智能体攻击成功率高达86.3%，且现有防御措施效果有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅评估单次任务执行中的中毒技能，并通过临时风险列表枚举危害，缺乏对技能使用全生命周期中风险的系统性分类与评估。

Method: 构建SkillHarm基准，定义FPP（固定载荷投毒）和SMP（自变异投毒）两类攻击场景，基于数据管道、系统环境和智能体自治性三个维度定义12种风险类型；并开发AutoSkillHarm自动化构建管线，由编码智能体配合自然语言指令驱动生成攻击样本。

Result: 生成包含71个技能、879个攻击样本的基准测试集，实验发现FPP攻击成功率最高达86.3%，SMP达69.3%。进一步分析表明，许多攻击失败源于智能体未接触中毒文件而非真正抵御，现有防御措施仍不可靠。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在面对技能投毒攻击时仍高度脆弱，需要更系统的防御机制来应对技能生命周期中的安全威胁。

Abstract: Agent skills occupy a privileged position in the agent workflow, as agents are expected to implicitly follow and execute them, rendering third-party skills a vulnerable attack surface. Existing studies have revealed unsafe agent behaviors induced by skill-based attacks, but they primarily evaluate poisoned skills within a single task execution and enumerate harms through ad-hoc risk lists. To bridge these gaps, we introduce SkillHarm, a benchmark of skill-based attacks across the skill-use lifecycle, paired with a systematic taxonomy of skill-relevant risks. SkillHarm evaluates two attack scenarios: Fixed-Payload Poisoning (FPP), where a fixed poisoned skill package directly compromises any task session that invokes it, and Self-Mutating Poisoning (SMP), where an initially benign execution silently mutates persistent skill content, deferring harm until a subsequent reuse. It further defines 12 risk types based on the agent workflow component targeted by the harm: data pipelines, system environments, and agent autonomy. To instantiate these attacks at scale, we build AutoSkillHarm, an automated construction pipeline with coding agents driven by natural-language harnesses. The resulting benchmark contains 879 attack samples across 71 skills. Experiments show that current agents remain vulnerable with attack success rates up to 86.3% in FPP and 69.3% in SMP. Our analysis further reveals a latent risk: many apparent attack failures stem from the agent failing to engage with the poisoned file rather than genuine resistance, and current defenses still fail to reliably mitigate the threat.

</details>


### [484] [SimSD: Simple Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02544)
*Junxia Cui,Haotian Ye,Runchu Tian,Hongcan Guo,Jinya Jiang,Haoru Li,Chaojie Ren,Yiming Huang,Kaijie Zhu,Zhongkai Yu,Kun Zhou,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SimSD算法，通过即插即用的掩码策略使扩散大语言模型具备逐令牌投机验证能力，在保持生成质量的同时实现高达7.46倍的解码吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)虽然可通过并行或块解码实现快速推理，但其掩码语言建模公式与标准逐令牌投机解码不兼容——dLLMs使用掩码令牌和双向注意力，导致有效上下文在去噪步骤间变化，无法直接进行逐令牌投机验证，限制了其加速潜力。

Method: 提出SimSD，一种即插即用的掩码策略：引入草稿模型预测的参考令牌，设计注意力掩码来调节参考令牌与当前步令牌的交互，使dLLMs能在单次前向传播中计算草稿令牌的有效logits，从而恢复AR模型中因果掩码提供的验证能力，同时保持dLLM的并行解码优势。

Result: 在SDAR系列dLLMs上、跨四个基准测试，SimSD实现高达7.46倍的解码吞吐量提升，同时维持甚至提升平均生成质量。该方法无需训练，可灵活集成KV缓存和块解码等其他加速技术。

Conclusion: SimSD有效弥合了dLLMs与投机解码之间的鸿沟，是一种训练无关、即插即用的加速方案，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提升dLLM的解码速度。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, offering faster inference through parallel or blockwise decoding. However, their masked language modeling formulation remains incompatible with standard token-level speculative decoding, one of the most effective acceleration techniques for AR models. In AR decoding, the causal mask preserves temporally valid token-level contexts, enabling a target model to verify multiple drafted tokens in a single forward pass. In contrast, dLLMs rely on mask tokens and bidirectional attention, causing the effective context to change across denoising steps and preventing direct token-level speculative verification. To bridge this gap, we propose a simple but effective speculative decoding algorithm for diffusion language models, named SimSD, which mainly adopts a plug-and-play masking strategy that equips dLLMs with temporally valid token-level contexts for speculative decoding. Our method explicitly introduces reference tokens from draft-model predictions and designs an attention mask that regulates their interaction with current-step tokens, allowing dLLMs to compute valid logits for drafted tokens in a single forward pass. This restores the key verification ability provided by causal masking in AR models while preserving the parallel decoding advantages of dLLMs. The proposed method is training-free and can be flexibly integrated with other acceleration techniques such as KV cache and blockwise decoding. Experiments on SDAR-family dLLMs across four benchmarks show that our method achieves up to 7.46x higher decoding throughput while maintaining and even improving average generation quality.

</details>


### [485] [Transferable Self-Harm Surveillance from Emergency Department Triage Notes Using an Evidence-Augmented Machine Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02545)
*Liuliu Chen,Gowri Rajaram,Eleanor Bailey,Katrina Witt,Michelle Lamblin,Jo Robinson,Mike Conway,Vlada Rozova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种三阶段方法，将传统机器学习和大型语言模型相结合，用于从急诊分诊记录中检测自伤行为，并在三家澳大利亚医院验证了模型的跨机构迁移性。该方法不仅实现了高AUPRC值（内部验证0.887，外部验证0.884），还能以95%的准确率识别自伤主要方式，支持更细粒度的监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自伤行为监测主要依赖医院诊断编码，但编码灵敏度低，导致监测不充分。急诊分诊记录作为初始接触点的简要摘要，为识别自伤提供了机会，亟需开发更有效的自动化检测方法。

Method: 开发了一种三阶段方法：在传统机器学习基础上，结合基于大型语言模型（LLM）的筛查和证据提取，用于检测急诊分诊记录中的自伤行为。在三家澳大利亚医院评估了模型的跨机构迁移性。

Result: 内部验证AUPRC为0.887±0.016，外部验证为0.884±0.012。前瞻性验证中，开发站点AUPRC为0.881±0.008，两个外部站点（无需站点特异性重训练）分别为0.879±0.012和0.816±0.015。自伤主要方式的识别准确率达95%。

Conclusion: 该三阶段方法能有效从急诊分诊记录中检测自伤行为，具有良好的跨站点迁移性，且超越了简单的二分类，能够识别自伤方式，支持更细粒度的监测。

Abstract: Self-harm is a major public health concern, but current surveillance relying on hospital presentations is inadequate due to the low sensitivity of diagnostic codes. Emergency Department (ED) triage notes, recorded at the initial point of contact, provide a succinct summary of presentations and an opportunity to identify self-harm. We developed a three-stage approach, augmenting traditional machine learning with large language model-based screening and evidence extraction to detect self-harm in ED triage notes. We assessed model transferability across three Australian hospitals. Our approach showed AUPRCs of 0.887 +/- 0.016 and 0.884 +/- 0.012 during internal and external validation. Prospectively, it achieved AUPRC of 0.881 +/- 0.008 at the development site, and 0.879 +/- 0.012 and 0.816 +/- 0.015 at two external sites without site-specific retraining. A key advantage of the approach is that it enables identification of the primary self-harm method with an accuracy of 95%, supporting more granular surveillance beyond binary classification.

</details>


### [486] [SN-WER: Script-Normalized WER for Multi-Script Indic ASR Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02548)
*Priyaranjan Pattnayak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出脚本归一化词错误率（SN-WER），一种无需训练、仅用于评估的指标，通过在计算WER前将参考文本和假设文本音译为语言特定的规范脚本，解决ASR在多语言场景下因罗马化导致的WER虚高问题。在5种印度语言、2个数据集和3个ASR模型上的实验表明，SN-WER可缓解高达12%的模型差距膨胀，对人工罗马化引起的WER膨胀有67%的衰减，且对语义错误保持近乎相同的敏感度，建议作为WER和CER的补充指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WER指标在多语言ASR场景中，当参考文本与假设文本使用不同书写系统（如参考为天城文、假设为罗马化文本）时，会错误地将同词不同脚本的情况计为错误，导致WER虚高并夸大模型间差距。需要一种脚本无关的评估方法来解决这一问题。

Method: 提出SN-WER方法，在计算WER之前，先将参考文本和假设文本通过音译（transliteration）转换为语言特定的规范脚本，再执行标准WER计算。该方法无需训练，仅用于评估阶段。

Result: 在5种印度语言、FLEURS和Common Voice两个数据集、3种ASR模型上：1) FLEURS上SN-WER减少高达12%的膨胀模型差距；2) Common Voice上改善较小或不一致，表明存在真实识别缺陷；3) 人工罗马化压力测试中WER膨胀衰减67%；4) 词汇替换控制显示Delta SN-WER/Delta WER≈1.09，对语义错误敏感度接近；5) 对音译器选择和归一化方式鲁棒，令牌碰撞率低于0.1%。

Conclusion: SN-WER应作为WER和CER的补充指标，用于脚本不敏感的ASR评估，特别是在转录结果用于下游搜索、索引或多语言LLM流水线的场景中。

Abstract: Word Error Rate (WER) is the dominant metric for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but it can overestimate errors when references and hypotheses encode the same words in different scripts. This issue is common in multilingual settings where ASR models may emit romanized text. We propose Script-Normalized WER (SN-WER), a training-free, evaluation-only scoring method that transliterates both reference and hypothesis text into a language-specific canonical script before computing WER. We evaluate SN-WER on 5 Indic languages, 2 datasets, and 3 ASR models. On curated FLEURS data, SN-WER reduces inflated model gaps by up to 12%, while on noisier Common Voice data the reductions are smaller or inconsistent, indicating genuine recognition weaknesses rather than only script mismatch. Controlled stress tests show a 67% attenuation of artificial romanization-induced WER inflation, while lexical-substitution controls show near-identical sensitivity to semantic errors, with Delta SN-WER / Delta WER approximately 1.09. SN-WER is robust to transliterator choice, normalization changes, and shows low token-collision rates below 0.1% in the evaluated Indic setting. We argue that SN-WER should be reported alongside WER and CER as a companion metric for script-insensitive ASR evaluation, especially when transcripts feed downstream search, indexing, or multilingual LLM pipelines.

</details>


### [487] [HERO'S JOURNEY: Testing Complex Rule Induction with Text Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02556)
*Anshun Asher Zheng,Kanishka Misra,David I. Beaver,Junyi Jessy Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了HERO'S JOURNEY基准，用于评估AI在目标导向情节任务中的规则归纳能力，发现当前LLMs在该能力上有限且不均衡，程序性归纳仍是开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对目标驱动情节任务中规则归纳的系统评估，尤其是在多步执行和可控条件下的归纳能力测试。

Method: 设计了涵盖属性归纳和程序归纳两大类的8个任务，每个任务包含4种结构规则形式、可控词汇基础与可辨识条件。评估了多个SOTA LLMs。

Result: LLMs展现出一定规则归纳能力但有限且不均衡；过程执行成为执行瓶颈；表面语义影响很小；归纳导向的引导方法在属性任务上有效，但在程序任务上无可靠提升。

Conclusion: 程序性归纳仍是当前LLMs的开放挑战，需要进一步研究以弥合这一能力差距。

Abstract: We introduce HERO'S JOURNEY, a benchmark for rule induction in goal-directed episodic tasks, where agents must infer hidden rules from demonstrations and act on them through multi-step execution. HERO'S JOURNEY covers eight tasks across attribute and procedural induction families, each with four structural rule forms, controllable lexical grounding, and identifiability conditions. Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that models show evidence of rule induction, but the ability is limited and uneven across tasks. Meanwhile, process execution adds an execution bottleneck for models, whereas surface semantics has minimal effect. Induction-specific steering methods improve performance on attribute tasks but show no reliable gains on procedural tasks, suggesting the gap in procedural induction remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [488] [From Layers to Submodules: Rethinking Granularity in Replacement-Based LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02559)
*Elia Cunegatti,Marcus Vukojevic,Erik Nielsen,Giovanni Iacca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SubFit是一种子模块级别的LLM后训练压缩方法，通过非连续选择注意力与前馈子模块并为其添加轻量级残差旁路，在10个LLM、5种稀疏度下优于现有方法，25%稀疏度时保持84.6%的下游准确率，困惑度仅退化2.42倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM压缩方法（如删除或替换完整层）受限于两个约束：全层粒度和连续选择。作者认为预训练Transformer中的冗余并非连续分布，且注意力与前馈子模块的最佳近似策略不同，可移除组件也不一定集中在连续深度范围内，因此需要更细粒度的非连续压缩方法。

Method: SubFit在子模块级别（Attention和FeedForward子模块）非连续地选择可移除组件，并为每个选中的子模块分配一个轻量级拟合残差旁路（fitted residual bypass）。该方法仅需少量校准数据，属于后训练压缩。

Result: 在10个LLM（5个基础模型+5个指令微调模型）、5种稀疏度（12.5%~37.5%）和4种基线方法的对比中，SubFit实现了最优的困惑度-准确率权衡。25%稀疏度下，SubFit保留84.6%下游准确率、困惑度退化2.42倍，而最强基线仅保留81.6%准确率且困惑度退化4.34倍。同时获得了可测量的推理加速和KV缓存节省。

Conclusion: 打破全层粒度和连续选择的约束，在子模块级别进行非连续压缩是更有效的LLM后训练压缩策略，尤其在激进压缩场景下优势更明显。

Abstract: Post-training compression of Large Language Models (LLMs) removes entire architectural components, either deleting them or replacing them with fitted modules. Existing replacement-based methods share two design constraints: full-layer granularity and contiguous selection. We argue that this is overly restrictive: in fact, redundancy in pretrained transformers is not confined to contiguous regions, nor does it evenly distribute between Attention and FeedForward outputs, implying that different strategies best approximate different submodule types and that removable components need not cluster within contiguous depth ranges. Based on this intuition, we introduce SubFit (Submodule-level Fitted residual replacement), which compresses LLMs at the submodule level: Attention and FeedForward submodules are selected non-contiguously, and each receives its own lightweight fitted residual bypass. SubFit operates post-training and requires only calibration data. Across ten LLMs (five base, five instruction-tuned), five sparsity levels from 12.5% to 37.5%, and four replacement-based baselines, SubFit achieves the best aggregate perplexity-accuracy trade-off across the evaluated sparsity levels, with larger gains under aggressive compression. At 25% sparsity, it retains 84.6% of dense downstream accuracy and incurs 2.42x perplexity degradation, against 81.6% and 4.34x for the strongest baselines, while delivering measurable inference speedup and KV-cache savings. Code is available at https://github.com/eliacunegatti/SubFit.

</details>


<div id='cs.GR'></div>

# cs.GR [[Back]](#toc)

### [489] [PaintBench: Deterministic Evaluation of Precise Visual Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00188)
*Kai Xu,Ellis Brown,Shrikar Madhu,Rob Fergus,He He,Saining Xie*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: PaintBench是一个动态可扩展的基准测试，涵盖20种精确视觉编辑操作（几何变换、结构操作、颜色变化、符号推理），通过程序化生成实现无限且抗污染的评估。测试11个模型，最佳模型仅得17.1%（mIoU），且发现模型在不同操作类型和场景复杂度上表现差异显著，并与实际任务性能高度相关（R²=0.91）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态模型在开放式视觉编辑方面表现良好，但在执行精确的单答案编辑操作方面仍存在重要障碍，缺乏系统、可扩展且无偏见的评估基准。

Method: 提出PaintBench基准，通过程序化生成方式实现20种精确视觉编辑操作（分属几何变换、结构操作、颜色变化、符号推理四类），支持动态配置复杂度以生成无限抗污染评估集，采用确定性像素级评估（mIoU）替代有偏见的评判模型。同时创建TinyGrafixBench用于泛化性验证。

Result: 11个图像编辑模型中最高分仅17.1%（mIoU）。几何变换、大部分结构操作、基于公式的颜色变化尤为困难。场景变化（物体数量、背景复杂度、配色方案、编辑区域大小）会导致性能下降。PaintBench评分与TinyGrafixBench实际任务性能呈强线性相关（R²=0.91, p<0.001）。

Conclusion: PaintBench为精确多模态视觉编辑提供了严谨的评估基础，能够有效衡量和推动该领域的进步。

Abstract: While current multimodal models are proficient at open-ended visual editing, executing precise single-answer edits remains an important obstacle. To probe this challenge, we introduce PaintBench, a dynamically scalable benchmark targeting 20 fundamental precise visual editing operations across four categories: geometric transformation, structural manipulation, color change, and symbolic reasoning. Procedural generation with configurable complexity enables an effectively infinite, contamination-resistant evaluation suite, and deterministic pixel-level evaluation eliminates reliance on bias-prone judge models. Across 11 image editing models, we find overall low performance, with the current highest-performing industry leader scoring only 17.1% (mIoU). Task decomposition reveals especially challenging operation types (geometric transformation, most structural manipulation, formula-based color change) and model-specific specializations. Fine-grained benchmark diagnostics further show performance degradations induced by scene variations in object count, background complexity, color scheme, and edit-region size. To test generalization of PaintBench scores to applied task performance, we create a procedural, deterministic evaluation for data visualization editing (TinyGrafixBench) and find strong linear correlation with PaintBench scores ($R^2 = 0.91$, $p < 0.001$). Altogether, PaintBench provides a rigorous foundation for measuring and driving progress in precise multimodal visual editing.

</details>


### [490] [Subgrid Marching Tetrahedra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00454)
*Hossein Baktash,Mark Gillespie,Keenan Crane*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出子网格行进算法，利用广义法坐标编码任意整数交点数，在四面体网格中恢复无交叠流形三角网格，突破奈奎斯特-香农极限，能在单细胞内捕捉任意多表面片与薄特征，无需定义内外方向或一致朝向输入几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典行进立方体/四面体算法受限于每个单元只能生成单一表面片，无法处理薄特征与精细细节，且依赖明确定义的内外方向与一致朝向输入。

Method: 从几何拓扑中推广法坐标概念，沿网格边编码任意整数相交计数以表示表面连接性；在四面体单元内独立执行局部重建，生成跨单元一致的流形网格。

Result: 在相同计算时间、相同网格分辨率或相同输出三角形数下，子网格行进生成的网格精度远优于经典行进算法；可处理薄片、多表面片、带边界曲面及多边形汤。

Conclusion: 该方法保留了经典行进的局部并行特性，同时突破了网格分辨率对特征尺寸的下界限制，为任意复杂表面的高质量重建提供了通用框架。

Abstract: We describe a method for recovering a manifold, intersection-free triangle mesh from the points where edges of a tetrahedral grid pierce a continuous surface. Unlike classic marching cubes or tets, our subgrid marching scheme allows arbitrarily many surface patches within a single cell, capturing fine features and thin sheets. Moreover, it requires neither a well-defined inside/outside (allowing surfaces with boundary), nor consistently-oriented input geometry. Yet we retain the local, parallel nature of classic marching: reconstruction is performed independently per tet, yielding a conforming mesh across tet boundaries. Our key innovation is a generalization of normal coordinates from geometric topology, which encode surface connectivity via arbitrary integer intersection counts along each grid edge. This encoding sidesteps the usual Nyquist--Shannon limit, putting no lower bound on the size of features that can be resolved on a fixed grid. In practice, for similar compute time and equal grid resolution -- or even an equal number of output triangles -- meshes produced by subgrid marching are far more accurate than those from classic marching. Beyond standard contouring, our method can be used to convert polygon soup into a manifold, intersection-free mesh.

</details>


### [491] [Directed Distance Fields for Constant-Time Ray Queries on Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00817)
*Subhankar MIshra*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景转换为射线查询器（ray oracle）的有向距离函数（DDF）方法。DDF是一个小型神经场，输入射线原点与方向，输出到首个表面的距离及是否命中。该场仅52MB，大小不随高斯数量增长。实验表明：DDF比等效有符号距离场的球体追踪快26-72倍，且查询时间和内存不随场景规模增长。最终用于全局光照中的次级射线查询，在142个物体上实现30.3dB的阴影和21.3dB的环境光遮蔽重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS只能处理初级射线（从相机穿过图像的射线），无法追踪阴影、环境光遮蔽和全局光照所需的次级射线，限制了其在复杂光照效果渲染中的应用。

Method: 设计一个轻量级神经场（DDF），以射线原点+方向为输入，预测到首个表面的距离及是否命中。使用从3DGS场景中蒸馏出的清洁距离监督训练，而非模糊的深度渲染图。无需网格，仅需图像生成3DGS场景，再从神经表面提取清洁距离。

Result: DDF大小为52MB且不随场景规模增长；比等效SDF球体追踪快26-72倍；相比基于高斯构建的BVH层次包围盒，查询时间和内存不随场景增长；在142个物体上实现30.3dB阴影和21.3dB环境光遮蔽重建质量。

Conclusion: DDF作为次级射线查询器能有效实现全局光照效果，兼具存储效率高、查询速度快、无网格依赖等优势，为3DGS场景的复杂光照渲染提供了实用方案。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders new views of a scene in real time. Like every rasterizer, it answers only primary rays, the rays from the camera through the image. It cannot trace the secondary rays that shadows, ambient occlusion, and global illumination need. We turn a trained 3DGS scene into a ray oracle by distilling a Directed Distance Function (DDF). The DDF is a small neural field. It takes a ray, given by an origin and a direction, and returns the distance to the first surface and whether the ray hits anything. Each query is one forward pass. The field is 52~MB, and its size does not depend on the number of Gaussians, so its cost and memory stay flat as the scene grows. We make three points. First, we study what supervision a DDF needs. Depth rendered from the Gaussians is too blurry to teach thin parts, while clean distance supervision recovers them. Second, we measure speed. The DDF is 26 to 72 times faster than sphere tracing an equivalent signed distance field, and unlike a bounding volume hierarchy built over the Gaussians, even on dedicated RT-core hardware, its query time and memory do not grow with the scene. Third, we show a pipeline that needs no mesh: images give a 3DGS scene, a neural surface gives clean distances, and the DDF learns from them. We use the DDF as a secondary-ray oracle for global illumination. It reproduces reference ray-traced shadows at 30.3~dB and ambient occlusion at 21.3~dB across 142 objects, and on real captured scenes. Our codes are available at https://github.com/smlab-niser/ddf-gs.

</details>


### [492] [Temporally-Aligned Evaluation for Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01031)
*Zhicheng Zhang,Lei Wang,Yu Zhang,Yongsheng Gao*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文指出现有音频驱动说话头生成评估依赖逐帧指标，未能处理时序偏移、语速差异等自然变化，提出将评估重构为序列对齐问题，引入软动态时间规整（Soft-DTW）到评估流程中，实现序列级对齐评估，并在20种方法、7个数据集上验证了该方法的鲁棒性和一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估协议主要采用逐帧指标，假设生成视频与参考视频之间存在严格的时间对应关系，但这与语音驱动的面部运动的自然特性（如时序偏移、语速差异、风格变化）不符，导致无害的时序差异被误判为质量错误，难以公平比较不同方法并理解其权衡。

Method: 将评估重新形式化为序列对齐问题，提出将软动态时间规整（Soft Dynamic Time Warping）集成到现有评估流程中，在对齐特征轨迹的同时保持时序顺序，从而对有限时序错位具有鲁棒性，且不改变底层的感知、身份或同步编码器。

Result: 在20种方法、7个数据集上的大规模基准测试表明，时序对齐的指标对时序差异更鲁棒，跨数据集提供更一致的结果，并能更好地揭示建模范式之间的系统性权衡（如同步性与真实感、表现力与稳定性）。

Conclusion: 逐帧评估可视为刚性对齐下的特例，而序列级对齐提供了更好的稳定性、对时序差异更低的敏感性以及建模范式之间更清晰的区分度，为推动动态生成模型评估标准化提供了新方向。

Abstract: Audio-driven talking-head generation has advanced rapidly, yet existing evaluation protocols mainly rely on frame-wise metrics that assume strict temporal correspondence between generated and reference videos. This assumption does not match speech-driven facial motion, which naturally includes slight timing shifts, different speaking speeds, and stylistic variations. As a result, conventional metrics may treat harmless timing differences as quality errors, making it harder to fairly compare methods and understand their trade-offs. In this work, we argue that evaluation of dynamic generative models should be formulated as a sequence-alignment problem rather than independent frame comparison. We introduce a unified sequence-level reformulation that integrates Soft Dynamic Time Warping into established evaluation pipelines. By aligning feature trajectories while preserving temporal order, the proposed framework provides robustness to bounded temporal misalignments without altering the underlying perceptual, identity, or synchronization encoders. We show that frame-wise evaluation can be viewed as a special case under rigid alignment, while sequence-level alignment provides improved stability, lower sensitivity to timing differences, and clearer separation between modeling paradigms. Building on this principled formulation, we conduct a large-scale benchmark of 20 methods across seven datasets spanning canonical, in-the-wild, and style-diverse scenarios under standardized protocols. Extensive experiments show that temporally aligned metrics are more robust to timing differences, provide more consistent results across datasets, and better reveal systematic trade-offs between modeling paradigms, such as synchronization versus realism and expressiveness versus stability.

</details>


### [493] [AlbedoEdit: Unified Instance-Level Video Editing with Albedo Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01362)
*Xilong Zhou,Bao-Huy Nguyen,Zheng Zeng,Jacob Munkberg,Jon Hasselgren,Thomas Leimkühler,Nima Kalantari,Miloš Hašan,Christian Theobalt*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: AlbedoEdit是一个统一的视频生成编辑框架，利用光照不变的固有反照率图，支持对象插入、删除和纹理编辑，通过微调视频基础模型实现细粒度实例级编辑，并在新合成的配对数据集上训练，性能优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法要么仅支持粗粒度的语义控制，要么针对单个编辑任务设计专用框架，缺乏灵活性和泛化能力，难以满足多样化的细粒度实例级视频编辑需求。

Method: 提出AlbedoEdit框架，利用光照不变的反照率图作为用户友好的编辑控制信号，基于视频基础模型微调，将源RGB视频转换为编辑后的RGB视频，以用户编辑的第一帧反照率为条件，并在覆盖三种编辑任务的配对合成数据集上训练，隐式学习编辑内容的和谐化及模拟复杂视觉特效。

Result: 在对象插入、对象删除和纹理编辑三个任务上，AlbedoEdit在定性和定量评估中均优于现有最先进的视频编辑方法。

Conclusion: 反照率图作为编辑控制信号能有效支持多种细粒度视频编辑任务，统一的生成框架可隐式学习编辑后的视觉和谐化与复杂光照效果模拟。

Abstract: Video generative models have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing photorealistic video sequences. However, enabling broader and more creative downstream applications requires fine-grained instance-level video editing, including object insertion, object removal, and texture editing, which has emerged as a prominent yet challenging problem. Existing approaches either propose unified generative frameworks with only coarse semantic control, or design task-specific frameworks for individual editing tasks, limiting their flexibility and applicability across diverse real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose AlbedoEdit, a unified generative video editing framework that jointly supports object insertion, object removal, and texture editing. Our key insight is that the intrinsic albedo map, which is invariant to lighting and contains no specularity, shadowing and inter-reflection effects, provides an effective and user-friendly mechanism for specifying fine-grained appearance edits. Built upon video foundation models, AlbedoEdit is fine-tuned to translate source RGB videos into edited RGB videos, conditioned on a user-edited first-frame albedo. Trained on a new paired synthetic dataset covering all three editing tasks, AlbedoEdit implicitly learns to harmonize edited contents and simulate complex real-world visual effects triggered by editing operations, including specular highlights, soft shadows, and mirror reflections. AlbedoEdit demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art video editing approaches, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Project webpage is https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/AlbedoEdit/.

</details>


### [494] [MPMWorlds: Material-Point-Method Simulations for Inferring and Extrapolating Physical Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01538)
*Žiga Kovačič,Kevin Ellis*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个包含丰富物理现象的2D MPM仿真数据集，研究从视频推断物理动力学并外推的能力，比较了代码生成与视频扩散两种方法的优劣。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究从视频中推断物理动力学并进行时间外推的能力，探索不同方法（代码生成与视频扩散）在这项任务上的表现差异。

Method: 构建2D MPM物理仿真数据集，涵盖可变形物体、流体、动力学物体和发射器等物理现象；分别采用代码生成和视频扩散两种方法进行实验，并通过改变物理侧信息的输入量来对比两者的优缺点。

Result: 代码生成方法能从视觉输入自动合成MPM仿真，但在推断物理参数方面存在困难；视频扩散方法能更准确地从视觉输入识别几何属性，但产生的外推结果在物理上不真实。代码生成在时间和物理稳定性方面优于视频扩散。

Conclusion: 代码生成和视频扩散在物理动力学推断和外推任务上各有优劣：代码生成擅长保持物理和时间稳定性，但弱于物理参数推断；视频扩散擅长几何属性识别，但外推结果物理上不可靠。两者存在互补关系。

Abstract: To study the ability to infer physical dynamics from videos and extrapolate them forward in time, we assemble a dataset of 2D Material Point Method (MPM) physical simulations covering rich physical phenomena such as deformable objects, fluids, kinetic objects, and emitters. We study code generation and video diffusion approaches on this dataset, identifying their strengths and weaknesses by varying the amount of physically relevant side information. The code generation model, beyond giving a working demonstration of automatic synthesis of MPM simulations, reveals that such an approach struggles with inferring physical parameters from visual input, but relative to video diffusion, produces physically and temporally stable extrapolations forward in time, while the video diffusion model more strongly identifies geometric properties from visual input but produces physically implausible extrapolations.

</details>


### [495] [KDH-CAD: Knowledge-data hybrid CAD learning under data scarcity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01702)
*Ziqin Gao,Zhijie Yang,Qiang Zou*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: KDH-CAD提出了一种知识-数据混合框架，将预训练基础模型、结构化领域知识与少量标注CAD数据相结合，在不微调基础模型的情况下，通过领域知识激发和补全CAD相关概念，并用少量标注数据校准潜在空间中的几何变异性。在机械零件分类任务中，仅用250个训练样本即达92.6%准确率，1000样本达95.8%，以数量级更少的数据匹配或超越了现有最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CAD深度学习面临数据稀缺的根本性挑战：真实CAD数据难以大规模收集，而合成数据无法真实反映实际设计实践。本文不追求更大规模的CAD数据集，而是将CAD学习视为知识补全与校准问题。

Method: 提出KDH-CAD知识-数据混合框架，融合三类知识源：预训练基础模型中的先验知识、教科书/教程中的结构化领域知识、以及极少量标注CAD数据。利用领域知识激发和补全基础模型中弱表达或欠表示的CAD概念，通过少量标注数据在潜在空间中校准这些概念以适应任务特定的几何变异性，无需微调基础模型。

Result: 在真实机械零件分类任务上，250个训练样本达到92.6%准确率，1000样本达95.8%，且随数据增加持续提升。以数量级更少的数据匹配或超越现有最优性能。

Conclusion: 将预训练基础模型与结构化领域知识相结合，能够大幅降低对大规模CAD数据集的依赖，为数据高效的CAD学习提供了有原则且实用的方向。

Abstract: Deep learning in computer-aided design (CAD) remains fundamentally constrained by the data scarcity challenge: authentic CAD data is difficult to collect at scale, while synthetic data may not faithfully reflect real design practice. Rather than pursuing ever-larger CAD datasets, this paper alternatively treats CAD learning as a knowledge completion and calibration problem. It introduces KDH-CAD, a knowledge-data hybrid framework that integrates pretrained knowledge in foundation models, structured domain knowledge from textbooks/tutorials, and a very small amount of labeled CAD data. Domain knowledge is used to elicit and complete CAD-relevant concepts that are weakly expressed or under-represented in pretrained foundation models, while labeled CAD data calibrates these concepts in the latent space to account for task-specific geometric variability, without fine-tuning the foundation model. Experiments on real-world mechanical part classification show that KDH-CAD achieves strong performance in low-data regimes, reaching 92.6\% accuracy with only 250 training samples, 95.8\% with 1,000 samples, and continuing to improve with additional data. This matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance that typically requires an order of magnitude more data. These results suggest that combining pretrained foundation models with structured domain knowledge can substantially reduce reliance on large-scale CAD datasets, providing a principled and practical direction for data-efficient CAD learning.

</details>


### [496] [MidSurfNet: Learnable Face Pairing and Interference Implicit Fields for Generalized Mid-surface Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01891)
*Li Ye,Xinhang Zhou,Xingyu Yang,Ruofeng Tong,Hailong Li,Peng Du,Min Tang*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: MidSurfNet是一个学习增强框架，通过神经面配对模块和干涉隐式场两个创新组件，解决了薄壁CAD模型中面配对方法在复杂场景（多壁厚、自匹配、非中心偏移）下的失效问题，在1500+标注数据集上达到87.32%的面配对准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于面配对的薄壁CAD模型中面提取方法依赖手工几何启发式规则，在处理工业模型中常见的多壁厚区域、自匹配面配置及非中心偏移曲面时系统性失效，亟需一种能处理这些复杂场景的通用方法。

Method: 提出MidSurfNet框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 神经面配对模块，从几何和拓扑特征中学习预测面配对置信度；(2) 干涉隐式场，将中面表示为两个符号距离函数的干涉，实现通用偏移控制。构建了包含1500+手动标注CAD模型的大规模中面数据集。

Result: 面配对准确率达87.32%；多壁厚场景完成率61.90%；自匹配场景完成率52.94%，优于所有现有方法；支持面向CAE的任意偏移控制通用中面提取。

Conclusion: MidSurfNet首次以学习驱动方式实现了对复杂工业CAD模型中面的通用抽象，克服了规则方法的根本局限，为CAE/FEA工作流中的中面提取提供了灵活、准确的解决方案。

Abstract: Mid-surface abstraction is essential for finite element analysis of thin-walled CAD models. Existing face pairing-based methods rely on handcrafted geometric heuristics, yet real-world industrial models frequently exhibit multi-wall-thickness regions, self-matching face configurations, and demand for non-center offset surfaces--scenarios where rule-based approaches consistently fail. We present MidSurfNet, a learning-augmented framework that addresses these limitations through two novel components: (1) a neural face pairing module that learns to predict face pair confidence from geometric and topological features, handling complex pairing scenarios beyond rule-based methods; and (2) an interference implicit field that represents mid-surfaces as the interference of two signed distance functions, enabling generalized offset control for flexible positioning in downstream CAE/FEA-oriented workflows. We construct a large-scale mid-surface dataset containing over 1,500 manually annotated CAD models. Experiments demonstrate that MidSurfNet achieves 87.32% face pairing accuracy and successfully handles multi-wall-thickness (61.90% completion) and self-matching (52.94% completion) scenarios that confound all existing methods. Furthermore, MidSurfNet provides a learning-based approach to generalized mid-surface abstraction with arbitrary offset control for CAE-oriented applications.

</details>


### [497] [Single-Line Drawing Generation via Semantics-Driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01910)
*Tanguy Magne,Alexandre Binninger,Ruben Wiersma,Olga Sorkine-Hornung*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 提出首个语义驱动的单线矢量画生成方法，利用分数蒸馏采样优化URBS曲线参数，仅通过单条连续笔画即可根据文本描述或输入图像生成高质量单线画，支持刺绣、激光雕刻等下游制造工艺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单线画需艺术家高度抽象提炼主题精髓，现有方法缺乏语义驱动且难以保持单条连续笔画的特性，亟需一种自动化、可控制、支持矢量输出的生成方法。

Method: 采用均匀有理B样条（URBS）曲线作为矢量表征，通过分数蒸馏采样优化曲线参数，配合额外损失项控制艺术风格和细节层次，确保生成结果为单条连续笔画。

Result: 在美学质量和单线画艺术风格忠实度上优于现有文本到图像模型和优化管线，且直接支持刺绣、激光雕刻和金属丝弯曲等下游制造。

Conclusion: 语义驱动的单线矢量画生成方法首次实现基于文本或图像的自动化单线画创作，兼具艺术表现力与下游制造实用性。

Abstract: Line drawings are a highly expressive art form that requires the artist to abstract and distill the essence of their subject. We present the first semantics-driven method for automatically generating single-line drawings in vector format, guided either by a text prompt describing the concept or an input image depicting it. Our approach leverages score distillation sampling to optimize the parameters of a uniform rational B-spline (URBS) curve, ensuring that the drawing consists of a single continuous stroke by design. This representation provides fine-grained control over the level of detail, while additional loss terms allow us to steer the final artistic style. We demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art text-to-image models and optimization pipelines for this task, producing results that are both more aesthetically pleasing and more faithful to the style of continuous line drawing artists. Furthermore, because our method generates a vectorized curve, it directly supports downstream fabrication processes such as embroidery, laser engraving and wire bending. Our code and results are available at https://github.com/tanguymagne/SLDgen.

</details>


### [498] [Composable function systems as a general-purpose rendering framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02226)
*James Schloss*

Main category: cs.GR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于函数系统（Function Systems）的通用非分形可视化与模拟方法，并介绍了Quibble——一个用于在GPU上组合此类系统的元编程框架。该方法在运行时性能、拓扑非平凡对象创建及图形算法互操作性方面具有优势，可用于低帧率动画插帧、点云可控变形及复杂动画工作流的元编程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数系统为在GPU/CPU上以无网格方式创建和操作复杂对象提供了一种自然语言，同时保持极低的内存占用。现有方法在通用（非分形）可视化与模拟方面存在不足，需要一种更高效、灵活且内存友好的解决方案。

Method: 提出了一种基于函数系统的通用可视化与模拟方法，并设计了Quibble元编程框架，用于在GPU上组合和编译函数系统。该方法利用函数系统的迭代合成能力，通过元编程技术将高层描述转化为高效的GPU执行代码。

Result: 该方法在运行时性能上表现优异，能够创建拓扑非平凡的对象（如带有孔洞或自交结构的几何体），并与其他图形算法（如传统渲染管线、物理模拟）具有良好的互操作性。实际应用包括低帧率动画的插帧控制、点云的可控形变以及复杂动画工作流的元编程简化。

Conclusion: 函数系统结合元编程框架Quibble为GPU上的通用可视化与模拟提供了一种强大且高效的新范式，在性能、拓扑灵活性及工作流可编程性方面均优于传统方法，特别适合需要复杂对象生成和动画控制的场景。

Abstract: Function systems exist as a natural language for the meshless creation and manipulation of complex objects while maintaining minimal memory on the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) or Central Processing Unit (CPU). This paper proposes a new method for general-purpose (non-fractal) visualizations and simulations with function systems and introduces Quibble, a metaprogramming framework for composing such systems on the GPU. We also discuss several core advantages of this method including runtime performance, the creation of topologically non-trivial objects, and interoperability with other graphical algorithms. Beyond general-purpose imagery and animations, this method can also be used to give artists more control over in-between frames in low-framerate animations, controllably deform point clouds, and metaprogram difficult animation workflows.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [499] [Position Paper: Post-Solve Robustness in Decision Engines: Feasible Regions and Smoothness Under Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00002)
*Yi-Xiang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出混合整数线性规划（MILP）决策引擎存在后求解鲁棒性缺口：即使输出名义最优解，实际部署中微小扰动就可能导致解不可行或解空间剧烈跳变。作者呼吁在现有优化流水线中加入统一的后求解鲁棒性审计层，并形式化了ε-近优可行邻域和决策空间光滑性两个核心概念，综合了敏感性分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和学习增强等现有方法，提出了包含认证内逼近、概率鲁棒性估计、对抗鲁棒性边界以及学习预测与解释的研究议程和评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MILP决策引擎在工业高风险系统中输出名义最优解，但实际部署中成本、需求、资源可用性等微小扰动会导致解不可行或解空间不连续跳变。当前优化流水线缺乏对求解后鲁棒性的系统审计，这也是学习驱动决策系统缺失的一个评估维度。

Method: 形式化了两个核心对象：(i) ε-近优可行邻域——刻画参数空间中可使当前解保持可行且近优的邻域范围；(ii) 决策空间光滑性——刻画小组合编辑下的备选解是否仍具竞争力。综合了敏感性分析、稳定分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和学习增强等方法，提出统一审计层的四个具体方向：认证内逼近、概率鲁棒性估计、对抗鲁棒性边界、学习驱动的预测与解释。

Result: 本文是观点与议程类论文，没有提供实验性结果。核心贡献在于：(1) 识别并定义了后求解鲁棒性缺口这一被忽视的问题；(2) 形式化了ε-近优可行邻域和决策空间光滑性两个关键概念；(3) 系统综述了相关领域的碎片化进展；(4) 提出了统一鲁棒性审计层的研究议程和评估协议。

Conclusion: 呼吁将鲁棒性作为决策引擎的一等输出，提出紧凑的报告模板和评估协议，使鲁棒性审计成为优化流水线的标准组件，而非事后补救。

Abstract: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) decision engines routinely output nominally optimal plans for high-stakes industrial systems. Yet deployment rarely matches solve-time assumptions: small perturbations in costs, demands, or resource availability can invalidate feasibility or trigger discontinuous shifts to qualitatively different solutions. We argue that this post-solve robustness gap is a missing layer in today's optimization pipelines and a missing evaluation dimension for learning-enabled decision systems. Rather than replacing robust optimization or stochastic programming, the proposed layer audits a solved incumbent and returns solver-backed evidence about how far that solution can be trusted. We formalize two central objects: (i) an $ε$-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing when an incumbent remains feasible and near-optimal under perturbations, and (ii) solution smoothness in decision space, capturing whether nearby alternatives with small combinatorial edits remain competitive. We then synthesize the most relevant partial answers from sensitivity and stability analysis, robust optimization, neighborhood search, adversarial testing, and learning-based enhancements, and articulate an agenda for a unified post-solve robustness layer. Concretely, we call for certified inner approximations around the incumbent, probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty, adversarial robustness margins, and learning-based prediction and explanation aligned with solver-backed verification. We conclude with a compact reporting template and evaluation protocol that would make robustness a first-class output of decision engines.

</details>


### [500] [Emergent Collaborative Deliberation in Multi-Model AI Systems: A BFT-Derived Protocol for Epistemic Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00005)
*VD Doske*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Consilium协议是一种拜占庭容错衍生的结构化多模型AI deliberation架构，通过给语言模型分配认知人格角色，并引入金融领域的样本内/样本外验证框架，以极低成本（217美元完成全部实验）实现了与昂贵前沿模型相当的分析质量，同时揭示了RLHF对齐训练导致的领域特定认知盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI deliberation方法通常将模型间分歧视为噪声或错误，缺乏将分歧作为认知信号加以利用的系统性框架；同时，对齐训练对模型认知行为的影响尚未被充分量化研究。

Method: 基于拜占庭容错架构设计多模型 deliberation 协议；为每个模型分配工程化的认知人格（将模型本身与其推理方式分离）；引入金融领域的样本内/样本外（In-Sample/Out-of-Sample）验证框架来区分训练数据共识与经验验证结论。

Result: 认知人格而非底层模型决定认知行为（0.0002美元/批次的边缘模型产出与10.69美元/批次的前沿模型分析质量相当）；RLHF训练导致领域特定盲点（争议政策话题对抗性挑战比科学共识话题低12.3个百分点，AI安全话题存在11.6%的不对称偏差）；协议本身无方向性偏差；样本外验证100%检索239项声明并发现167个训练数据 deliberation 无法发现的盲点；重复性标准差±2.2%。

Conclusion: Consilium协议能够以极低成本实现高质量、可复现的多模型AI deliberation，揭示了认知人格设计和对齐训练的认知影响，为构建更可靠的AI讨论系统提供了可验证的开源方案。

Abstract: We present the Consilium Protocol, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error. The protocol assigns engineered cognitive personas to language models -- separating what a model is from how it reasons -- and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions.
